Additional Job Description

* Strong customer service and relationship management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.

* Familiarity with contracts, change orders, permits, invoicing, and project documentation.
* Experience coordinating activities among multiple stakeholders and project teams.

jobs.company: Lundquist Institute For Biomedical Innovation At Harbor-ucla
jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us:**  
The Lundquist Institute for Biomedical Innovation at Harbor-UCLA Medical Center is an independent, non-profit biomedical research organization located in Torrance, California. In dozens of laboratories throughout the campus, researchers are working to unravel the mysteries of heart and kidney disease, cardiac complications in newborns, chronic lung disease, skin cancer, sickle cell disease, disorders of the autoimmune system, and much more. Many of these projects are collaborative in nature, involving experts from different areas of specialization. Our discoveries have prevented blindness in newborns, enabled premature infants with fragile lungs to breathe and allowed children with rare, often fatal diseases to grow up healthy and strong.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in administration and/or office management in an academic healthcare setting. Desired experience with ACGME and other accrediting and regulatory bodies that affect resident and fellow education.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with absolute confidentiality.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Excellent organization skills with an ability to multitask and prioritize competing priorities.
* Must be comfortable working independently and in a collaborative team environment consisting of diverse
* populations of staff, faculty, resident/fellows and other administrative personnel.
* Must be able to adapt quickly to changes in work requirements and assignments in a proactive manner
* Strong critical and analytical thinking skills.

**Responsibilities:**

With oversight from the Program Director and Department Administrator, Medical Education, the Program Coordinator is responsible for the day-to-day administration of the ACGME residency/fellowship program(s). The Program Coordinator (PC) assists the Graduate Medical Education (GME) office and Program Director (PD) in developing and maintaining the educational quality of the training program and ensuring compliance with ACGME accreditation standards and Institutional requirements. The PC functions as a liaison between the GME office, PD, residents/fellows, medical students, participating sites, and other departments. The PC will continually assess a wide range of programmatic issues including maintaining databases, communicating with faculty and trainees regarding a range of issues, and collaborating with the GME office to plan annual events including recruitment, orientation, graduation, faculty development events, and various program-related events.

Program Accreditation and Compliance

* Develop understanding of ACGME policies and procedures, including familiarity with the Common
* Program Requirements, Specialty-Specific requirements, and Institutional Requirements.
* Maintain all essential documents required for program accreditation and ensuring program faculty possess the appropriate credential indicated by the program’s Review Committee. This includes confirming that
* CVs containing a current list of publications and scholarly activity are logged in ACGME WebADS system as required by ACGME.
* Assist the PD in maintaining the program’s ACGME WebADS system; keep a working copy and make changes on an ongoing basis.
* Manage and coordinate ACGME site visits, including preparation of the site visit documentation. Along with the PD, help prepare program, faculty, and residents/fellows for site visit; arrangement meeting rooms;ensure required documents are available to the site visitor as requested; and serve as key participate in the site visit.
* Prepare Program Letters of Agreement (in coordination with GME office leadership) with participating institutions and training sites. Ensure agreements are revised as needed.
* Under the direction of the PD, preparing the documentation for the Annual Program Evaluation for submission to the Institutional Sponsor as part of the annual Institutional required, as required by ACGME.
* Administer New Innovations Residency Management System for the program(s), including maintaining resident/fellow demographic data; resident/fellow schedules, importing program and rotation goals and objectives; conferences attendance tracking; and ensuring timely completion of duty hour reports.
* Ensure residents/fellows submit case/procedure log data in appropriate systems as required by ACGME Review Committee.
* Distribution of required documents to faculty and resident, including rotation goals and objectives, program manuals, program policies, etc.
* Establish and ensure compliance with program-specific credentialing requirements (e.g., ACLS, PALS, ATLS, etc.)
* Ensure resident/fellow compliance with Institutional credentialing and HR requirements, including medical licensees, DEA licenses, employee health, mandatory education training, and other training as required.
* Complete surveys and ensure information is current in various GME systems.
* Coordinate and staff various committees, including residency management meetings, faculty curriculum. committee meetings, departmental meetings, meetings with PD, and with the resident/fellows, and follow up on action items as required.
* Manage administrative and planning for logistics for meetings and conferences, including monthly lecture series, conferences, grand rounds, journal club, M&M, ACLS courses, and in-service exams
* Compile and submit required data elements to the Specialty Boards and other professional organizations as required.
* Administration of Resident/Fellow Activities In consultation with the PD, develop and maintain resident/fellows schedules, including rotation schedules, call schedules, and clinic schedules; maintain current schedules into New Innovations and update as needed.
* Coordinate information and schedules with other services, sites, and departments, including rotation/call schedules, and evaluations.
* In collaboration with GME office

jobs.title: Program Coordinator Social Services
jobs.description:
Meals on Wheels Orange County is the largest nonprofit provider of nutrition and supportive services for at-risk older adults. It is committed to erasing hunger and loneliness for at-risk older adults through nutritious meals, friendly visits and safety checks, and keeping families together through day services. Through its critical services, the organization delivers nearly 2 million meals to 20,000 at-risk older adults each year throughout Central and North Orange County. Meals on Wheels Orange County is a dba of Community SeniorServ, Inc.  
  
***Hours:*** *Mon-Fri, 8:30 am-5:00 pm*

***Level Status:*** *Full time/ with benefits*  
***Location:*** *Anaheim, Ca*

**Hourly Range:** $20.00 - $23.00 per hour (Hourly rate will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and experience)

**JOB SUMMARY:** This position is responsible for promoting, coordinating, managing, and for the day-to-day operations of the CHOICE Restaurant and To-Go Pilot Program, including completing enrollment and service delivery data entry, coordinating with Community Based Organizations (CBOs), promoting program participation, and troubleshooting other program areas as needed.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Program enrollment data entry adds new clients and assigns SeniorDine meal cards, completing client data entry and assessments in dual reporting systems; coordinates completion of annual program reassessments and completes reassessment data entry.
* Arranges delivery of SeniorDine cards to program participants; prints and mails welcome packets for Restaurant participants; prints scanning cards and delivers them to CBOs for To-Go participants.
* Verifies meals scanned in SeniorDine and ServTracker; makes corrections and updates seconds served in both reporting systems as needed before recording all units in WellSky.
* Coordinates directly with CBOs on collection of required documentation, answering compliance questions, providing status updates on meal allocations, and other promotional aspects of the program.
* Visits dine-in restaurants monthly to collect comment cards, nutrition education reporting, and other survey or reporting data; provides additional printed materials needed by restaurants for day-today program functions.
* Works directly with new Restaurants and CBOs to onboard them including providing training on program manual, SeniorDine system, and compliance requirements.
* Attends community events to promote the dine-in Restaurant program and collect interest lists or registration forms.
* Communicates program updates to CBOs and restaurants including updates from Office on Aging, Environmental Health Department, or Meals on Wheels Orange County.
* Supports other Social Services Department programs (Home Delivered Meals, Congregate Meals, In Home Services) and reporting and administrative functions as assigned.
* Attends staff meetings and training sessions as required.
* Performs other duties and assignments related to the CHOICE program, Social Services department, and company special projects as deemed necessary and appropriate.

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Associate Degree or equivalent preferred; comparable work experience in lieu of formal education will be considered.
* Must be able to work well with persons of all ages, especially elderly people.
* Must be familiar and have moderate experience with Microsoft Office Suite including Outlook, Word, Excel, and SharePoint; experience with client management software ServTracker and data tracking software WellSky or similar systems desirable.
* Be able to read, interpret and implement regulations, policies, and procedures.
* Must be able to maintain complex records and data;
* Valid California Driver's License and auto insurance as required by state, and ability to provide own transportation (vehicle) is required. Must maintain a clean DMV driving record and enroll in MOWOC’s DMV Pull Notice Program.

**PHYSICAL JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to travel frequently between multiple locations.
* Ability to use a computer keyboard, sit in a stationary position for extended periods, and use office equipment such a copy machine, printer, filing cabinets, and telephones.
* Constantly extends body, arms or hands as needed to perform essential duties and responsibilities.
* Occasionally ascends/descends and positions self as needed to complete essential duties and responsibilities.
* Workload requires constantly speaking, communicating, interpreting or exchanging information accurately.
* Constantly perceives objects over moderate or long distances, with or without accommodation.
* Ability to move, transport, and position objects weighing up to 50 pounds.

***Meals on Wheels Orange County is an equal-opportunity employer and encourages applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive work environment.***

jobs.title: Regional Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Tranzito**

Tranzito is a mobility operator specializing in micromobility, curbside management, and multimodal infrastructure for cities. We work with government agencies to help manage transportation programs for the public good -- we operate bike parking rooms and smart bike racks, bus stops, and other transit amenities. We partner with cities and transit agencies, like LADOT and LA Metro, to deploy and operate solutions that make citizens’ lives better and offer practical solutions to climate change. We deploy a systems integration strategy to stitch together off-the-shelf industrial components into a unique configuration.

**About the Position**

We are looking for a Regional Program Coordinator to support key Los Angeles programs, specifically the Sidewalk and Transit Amenities Program (STAP), LADOT Integrated Mobility Hubs (IMH) and other initiatives. Working closely with the Regional Program Manager, you will help coordinate the day-to-day execution of a complex, multi-agency pilot that integrates physical infrastructure with digital mobility services. This role is a great fit for someone with a foundation in public sector or infrastructure project coordination who wants to grow into program management.

**Job Overview**

The Regional Program Coordinator will support a diverse set of responsibilities ranging from schedule tracking and documentation to stakeholder coordination and field operations. The role involves a mix of desktop work, time in the field, and client meetings. You will keep regional programs organized and moving, ensuring that physical builds, digital integrations, and operational workflows stay on time and within budget. If you are organized, proactive, and comfortable moving between the office and the field, we encourage you to apply.

**Regional Program Coordinator Responsibilities & Duties**

**Program & Project Management**

* **Support the Project Management Plan:** Support the project’s governance, scope baseline, and delivery framework, ensuring all activities remain consistent with the approved scope, budget, and schedule.
* **Schedule & Risk Management:** Monitor the project schedule for variances, implement corrective actions for delays, and manage the Risk Register to proactively mitigate permitting, technology, or cost risks.
* **Support the Regional Program Manager**: Support the Regional Program Manager with tasks on an as-needed basis.
* **Support Corporatewide Project Management**: Support Tranzito with broad program management of Asana.

**Client & Stakeholder Coordination**

* **Secondary Point of Contact:** Serve as the secondary liaison for Los Angeles-based clients.
* **Attend and Organize Meetings:** Organize, prepare, and conduct minutes for regular and ad-hoc meetings with clients, partners, vendors, and internal.
* **Vendor & Subcontractor Management:** Facilitate coordination among diverse subcontractors (e.g., design, construction, technology) and third-party mobility partners (e.g., Metro Bike Share, TNCs) to ensure seamless service integration.

**Strategic Support**

* **Strategic Initiatives:** Assist the CEO and Regional Program Manager with strategic projects, including drafting RFP responses, creating operations documents, and conducting market research.

**Regional Program Coordinator Qualifications & Skills**

We are seeking candidates with 3–5 years of relevant experience in project coordination, transportation, public sector programs, or infrastructure.

* **Project Coordination:** Experience tracking schedules, deliverables, and documentation for public sector or infrastructure projects.
* **Operational Awareness:** Familiarity with field operations, maintenance workflows, or asset tracking.
* **Tool Proficiency:** Experience with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Forms, Sites), project management and communication tools such as Asana and Slack; experience with asset management software like Sitetracker is a plus.
* **LLM Utilization:** Ability to utilize LLMs (Large Language Models) for productivity and drafting.
* **Communication Skills:** Clear, organized writing and the ability to communicate professionally with agency staff, partners, and field crews.

**Attributes**

* **Critical Thinker:** Very smart and inquisitive with high critical thinking abilities.
* **Self-Motivated:** Driven to work hard independently and produce great quality work.
* **Organized:** Detail-oriented and reliable at keeping many moving pieces tracked and followed up on.
* **Communicator:** Great communication skills, capable of engaging effectively with everyone from executives to maintenance staff.
* **Passionate:** Loves transportation and believes in the greater mission of improving mobility.

**What you can expect working at Tranzito:**

* **Mission-first:** We are a self-funded, mission-driven company with people who want to improve mobility and help public agencies wisely use their investments to improve gridlock, boost equity and the environment.
* **Positive vibes:** We focus on building and maintaining a great work environment where everyone is trusted to work hard and maintain a great attitude, voicing input and opinions is encouraged, professional growth is fostered, and work/life balance is prioritized.
* **A startup culture:** While founded in 2002 and now with over 70 full-time employees, we retain a startup vibe with a thin executive and administrative team. You will wear many hats and be expected to be hands-on.

**Work Location**

This position will be based in Los Angeles. Regular field work will be required.

**Compensation**

* **$85,000 - $100,000 annually**
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with employer match
* Paid time off
* Paid parental leave
* Monthly cell phone reimbursement

jobs.title: RSVP Education Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About L.A. Works:** L.A. Works unites Angelenos and inspires action to help build a more equitable LA. As the largest 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization focused entirely on volunteer action, we create and manage hands-on programs that mobilize volunteers throughout the greater Los Angeles area to address the needs of vulnerable Angelenos. We seek enthusiastic, experienced individuals who share our passion for service and civic pride.

Additionally:

* Our work matters and has a direct, positive impact on our neighbors.
* We enjoy a casual but focused office atmosphere (we roll up our sleeves and get to work).
* We work on a hybrid model, primarily remote, with occasional in-person meetings or events.
* As an organization that specifically serves the Los Angeles community, we prefer to hire candidates who live locally.

**About RSVP:** AmeriCorps Seniors RSVP (Retired and Senior Volunteer Program) is one of the largest volunteer networks in the nation for adults age 55 and older. Through RSVP, older adults use their time, talents, and experience to make a meaningful difference in their communities. At L.A. Works, we believe the impact of volunteering extends far beyond the hours served. RSVP Volunteers build relationships across generations, share their skills, discover new purpose, and inspire others to serve. The result is a more robust community of nonprofits, healthier and more connected volunteers, and a more engaged Los Angeles.

**About the Role:** The RSVP Education Program Coordinator will lead the Education programming within L.A. Works' AmeriCorps Seniors RSVP program, with primary responsibility for Adult Education/Employment Readiness and K-12 Success.

This position is responsible for the successful implementation, growth, and day-to-day management of RSVP's Education programming, including volunteer recruitment and engagement, nonprofit partnerships, Volunteer Stations, Signature Projects, customized projects, grant deliverables, and program data.

The Education Program Coordinator will work closely with the RSVP Program Director, RSVP staff, Project Leaders, volunteers, nonprofit partners, and internal L.A. Works teams to ensure that Education programming is well organized, impactful, and aligned with AmeriCorps requirements and L.A. Works' mission.

Through strong organization, communication, relationship building, and follow through, this role will help ensure RSVP meets its grant commitments while creating meaningful and positive experiences for older adult volunteers and community partners.

This position also contributes to L.A. Works' long-term goal of reaching 500,000 volunteer service hours annually by 2035.

**Essential Job Functions**

The following list is not comprehensive; it is intended to provide a representative summary of the position's primary responsibilities. Incumbents may not be required to perform all roles listed and may be required to perform additional, position-specific tasks.

Program Operations

* Maintain a positive and collaborative team culture focused on accountability, continuous improvement, and meaningful community impact.
* Strengthen RSVP program operations by supporting consistent processes, clear communication, and effective coordination among staff, volunteers, and partners.
* Support the successful delivery of customized RSVP volunteer projects and other program activities that engage older adult volunteers.
* Manage grant-related documentation, prepare reports and supporting materials, and provide timely updates and information to the RSVP Program Director for final review and submission.
* Lead RSVP Adult Education and RSVP K-12 Tutoring recruitment eﬀorts in collaboration with the Outreach Coordinator.

**Program Management**

* Lead for Education RSVP programming by overseeing implementation, grant deliverables, performance goals, and day-to-day execution.
* Monitor progress toward RSVP goals and ensure activities remain aligned with AmeriCorps requirements and L.A. Works' mission.
* Identify challenges, recommend solutions, and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities to ensure successful grant implementation.
* Oversee the recruitment, placement, engagement, and retention of at least:
* 80 RSVP volunteers in K-12 Success
* 175 RSVP volunteers in Adult Education/Employment Readiness
* Lead and manage 7 Adult Education Signature Projects readiness workshops hosted by you or dedicated and trained L.A. Works volunteers (Project Leaders) virtually or at our partner sites with nonprofit organizations in L.A. County.
* Maintain or develop new relationships with at least:
* 12 Adult Education partners
* 5, K-12 nonprofit organization partners with current and active signed MOUs
* Plan and lead 5 RSVP customized projects.
* Collaborate with L.A. Works' FAVE Program to develop and support intergenerational programming and volunteer opportunities.

**Data and Volunteer Stations**

* Prepare grant report data for Education with supporting documentation, ensure information is accurate and complete, and provide timely updates to the Director of RSVP for review, approval, and submission to AmeriCorps.
* Train and support Project Leaders on data entry practices, documentation requirements, and procedures that promote data accuracy and consistency.
* Manage Volunteer Station agreements and ensure required documentation including MOU is maintained.
* Support Volunteer Stations in creating meaningful volunteer opportunities and addressing operational needs.
* Monitor Volunteer Station engagement and identify opportunities to strengthen partnerships and volunteer experiences.

**What Success Looks Like**

Grant Performance: Grant goals, deliverables, and volunteer engagement targets are achieved; challenges are identified early and addressed proactively.

Program Operations: RSVP activities run smoothly, with clear processes, strong communication, and effective coordination among staff, volunteers, and partners.

**Location:** Los Angeles, California
  
  
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
Join us in building a more inclusive world at Braille Institute of America. We are undertaking one of the most transformative initiatives in our history, planning our next century of success in serving the blind and visually impaired communities.
  
Through our 2025-2027 strategic planning process, we identified the next generation opportunities to advance critical initiatives in areas such as customer research; the expansion and transformation of current programs and services; the development of new nationally and internationally accessible programs; the creation of dynamic new strategic partnerships; and the alignment of our mission, strategy, and resources.
  
If you are ready to join a dynamic organization transforming the lives of individuals experiencing vision loss, we want you on our team.
  
  
WHO WE ARE
  
**At Braille Institute, we are driven by a shared purpose:** to serve the blind and low vision community. We come together to make a meaningful difference in the lives of others, finding fulfillment in the impact we create. We believe in fostering a culture that is collaborative, inclusive, and flexible.
  
We understand the importance of work-life balance, valuing both personal and professional fulfillment. Here, you'll find an environment that supports your well-being while providing opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive alongside colleagues who are sighted and visually impaired.
  
Join us in embracing technology and innovation as we shape the future of accessibility and positively transform the lives of those with vision loss.

General Expectations
  
  
All employees within Braille Institute are expected to support the organization’s mission, vision and values, work cooperatively with others, contribute to the positive morale of the department/center and be a respected representative of the organization.
  
  
Job Summary
  
  
The Production Coordinator is responsible for the planning, coordination, and live execution of all synchronous virtual learning sessions, events, and programs hosted on the Vision Support America (VSA) website and Braille Institute digital platforms. This role serves as the operational hub between Programs, Marketing, Information Technology, and Customer Service, ensuring that every live session is published accurately, supported technically, and delivered in a manner that reflects the organization’s commitment to accessibility and member experience.
  
  
Beyond live session management, the Production Coordinator plays an active quality-improvement role — analyzing session recordings, survey data, and participant feedback to identify patterns and opportunities for improvement, and providing direct coaching and support to session presenters. The position requires a practitioner who understands both the technical demands of virtual production and the specific needs of the organization’s primary audience: older adults who are new to vision loss.

Session Scheduling, Confirmation, and Publishing

* Coordinate audio and video setup, screen-share access, captioning activation, and any assistive technology configurations required for each session.
* Brief presenters prior to each session on platform controls, accessibility features, participant management, and any session-specific logistics.
* Monitor session quality in real time — audio clarity, video stability, caption accuracy, and participant accessibility — and intervene or escalate when issues arise.
* Maintain a post-session incident log documenting any technical issues, participant access barriers, or presenter needs that require follow-up.

Content Review and Quality Identification

* Flag and document specific moments in recordings for use in presenter coaching, quality reporting, or organizational learning.

**About the Role**

At Elevate Hive Marketing, the Account Manager helps keep client projects organised and moving forward. You'll work with clients to understand what they need, coordinate with our creative and digital marketing teams, and make sure everyone knows what needs to be delivered and when.

Some days will involve planning upcoming campaigns and agreeing on priorities. Others may mean resolving a delay, clarifying a brief, or helping a client understand the status of their work. The person in this role should be comfortable managing several projects at once, communicating directly, and keeping track of the details that can otherwise get missed.

**What You'll Handle**

* Build professional working relationships with clients and understand their marketing objectives, expectations, and priorities.

* Coordinate with creative and digital marketing colleagues to turn client requests into clear project briefs and deliverables.

* Keep track of campaign schedules, deadlines, approvals, and outstanding tasks.

* Give clients regular updates on progress and explain any changes that may affect delivery.

* Make sure the team has the information, files, and feedback needed to complete its work.

* Review deliverables against the agreed brief and coordinate revisions when necessary.

* Organise client meetings, record decisions, and follow up on agreed actions.

* Identify scheduling conflicts or scope changes early and work with the relevant people to resolve them.

* Maintain accurate project records so that client requests, decisions, and deadlines are easy to track.

* Help clients understand campaign progress and communicate performance information provided by the marketing team.

* Coordinate priorities across multiple accounts without losing sight of deadlines or client expectations.

* Look for practical ways to improve communication, handoffs, and day-to-day project management.

**What You'll Bring**

We're interested in people who can keep work organised, communicate clearly, and take responsibility for following up on commitments.

You should have:

* , client services, marketing coordination, project management, or a related role.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* The ability to manage several projects and deadlines at the same time.

* Good organisational skills and attention to detail.

* Confidence working with clients and coordinating tasks across different teams.

* A practical understanding of digital marketing services, creative projects, or campaign delivery.

* The ability to identify problems early and communicate them clearly.

* A dependable approach to tracking tasks, managing changes, and meeting agreed deadlines.

* Comfort using spreadsheets, shared documents, email, and project management tools.

Experience working with a marketing agency or managing multiple client accounts is useful.

**How We Work**

We expect clear communication, accurate project records, and realistic updates about progress. When a deadline is at risk or a client request changes, the team should know what has happened, what remains outstanding, and what needs to happen next.

**Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM.**

**Location:** Long Beach, California.

Apply through Indeed with your current Resume. Include a brief description of your relevant client management or project coordination experience, the types of projects you've handled, and how you kept work organised across clients and teams.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Experienced
jobs.description:
**Your Role**

The Provider Network Management Team is responsible for the development, negotiation, implementation, and ongoing management of Blue Shield of California's provider contracting across California. The team oversees relationships and contractual arrangements with hospitals, health systems, medical groups, IPAs, and ACOs across Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medi-Cal, and other government-sponsored programs. The Executive Assistant, Experienced, will report to the VP, Provider Network Management. In this role you will serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external constituencies on all matters pertaining to the office of the executive and the leadership on the Provider Network Management Team. You will be the liaison to Network Strategy, Network Operations and Clinical Teams within Healthcare Quality & Affordability (HQA) Team; monitor and respond to emails, heavy scheduling and managing calendar meetings; organize and coordinate all travel and arrange special events and onsite/offsite events.

The Executive Assistant, Experienced must be creative, agile and nimble, and enjoy working in an entrepreneurial environment that is member-driven, results-driven, and service-oriented. The ideal individual will have the ability to exercise good judgment and high level of discretion, with strong written and verbal communication, scrupulous administrative and organizational skills, and the ability to maintain balance among multiple competing priorities. The Executive Assistant, Experienced position requires the ability to work independently as well as within a team environment on projects from inception to completion and must be able to work under pressure to handle a wide variety of activities and confidential matters with discretion.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.

**This person will be required to live within 50 miles of the Woodland Hills office. Hybrid in-office expectation will be 2x per week, 8x per month.**

  

**Your Work**

In this role, you will:

* Be responsible for providing analytical and specialized administrative support to relieve and assist executive managers with complex details and advanced administrative duties
* Collect and prepare information for use in discussions/meetings of executive staff and outside individuals
* Analyze problems, determine approach, compile and analyze data and prepare reports/recommendations
* Contact company personnel at all organizational levels to gather information and prepare reports
* Manage day-to-day organization of executive’s calendar, appointments, meetings, and related schedule
* Compose and prepare correspondence; arrange meeting agendas; monitor and respond to emails; scheduling and calendaring meetings; Research required information or background on organizations and individuals; prepare travel arrangements, expense reports, plans/coordinates and ensure the executive’s schedule is followed and respected; acts in a “gatekeeper” capacity, creating win-win situations for direct access to the executive
* Research, prioritize, and follow up on incoming issues and concerns addressed to the executive, including those of a sensitive or confidential nature; Consult with the executive in determining appropriate course of action, referral, or response; communicate directly, and on behalf of the executive with senior leaders and board members, and others on matters related to the organization’s initiatives and activities; Provide a bridge for clear communication and maintains credibility, trust and support between the office of the executive and the internal staff
* Work closely and effectively with the executive to keep the leader well informed of upcoming commitments and responsibilities and follows up appropriately; Act as a “barometer,” having a sense for the issues taking place in the internal and external environments and keeps the executive updated; Draft correspondence to the team, and other tasks that facilitate the executive's ability to effectively lead the organization; Prioritize conflicting needs; handles all matter expeditiously, proactively, and follows through on projects to successful completion, often with deadline pressures
* Serve as the day-to-day manager of office logistics; manages accounts receivable and payable, maintains office supplies, mail processing, and manages office protocols including space requirements, IT, equipment, phone protocols, etc.; Update and edit Shield Central page and coordinate with the team members on upcoming updates to publicize; Perform several high-level review functions including department financial performance against budget, and processing payment for vendors and related service contracts; sets up internal systems and protocols ensuring standardization of processes and a high level of efficiency; Provide back-up support to the other Network Management Executive Assistants and Administrative Support team as needed.
* Other duties as assigned to support the Provider Network Management Team.

  

**Your Knowledge and Experience**

* Requires a Bachelor’s degree or High School Diploma/GED and 4 years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree
* Requires at least 3 years of prior relevant experience executive support
* Requires 3 years of prior scheduling meetings and traveling for at least 1 senior level manager
* Requires this person to live within 50 miles of the Woodland Hills office
* Requires experience working at a health plan (managed care, government payer, or academic)
* Requires ability to occasionally travel to offsite team events and/or meetings as needed
* At least 3 years of experience supporting two or more leaders

jobs.title: Administrative Operations Assistant
jobs.description:
**Administrative Operations Assistant**  
  
**Caltech**

**Job Category:** Fulltime Regular  
**Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Overtime Eligible  
**Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based
  
  
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
IPAC is part of the Physics, Mathematics and Astronomy Division at Caltech. We are a dedicated team of scientists, engineers, and administrative professionals who provide science operations, user support, data and archive services, and scientific vision to maximize discovery with observatories both in space and on the ground. Our partners and collaborators span the broader scientific community and include individual researchers, science collaborations, projects, missions, and centers. Our work involves people and projects across IPAC, NASA and NSF programs, NASA centers including JPL and GSFC, Caltech, and public and private institutions across the U.S. and internationally.  
  
IPAC's Administrative Team is seeking an Administrative Operations Assistant to join our group. If you are highly motivated, organized, and excited to support our team with day-to-day office operations, event coordination, recruitment support, and internal staff service, we encourage you to apply. This position is a great opportunity for someone interested in gaining hands-on experience in office administration while providing professional, high-level support in a collaborative and diverse environment.  
  
This position offers a diverse range of responsibilities and valuable experience within an academic research setting while supporting IPAC's core mission. The role is based in Pasadena, California.  
  
**Essential Job Duties**  
  
Reporting to the Staff Operations & Strategic Initiatives Lead, with day-to-day direction from the Senior Administrative Specialist, the Administrative Operations Assistant will:  

* Provide general office and administrative support, including routing inquiries, maintaining calendars, scheduling meetings and conference rooms, handling confidential information, and responding to routine staff requests. Provide backup support to other IPAC administrative staff as needed.
* Greet and assist visitors, respond to routine staff and guest inquiries, and receive and coordinate packages, vendors, and guide deliveries.
* Support conferences, workshops, meetings, and social events, including registration, catering, attendee communications, materials, supplies, payment tracking, and event setup and breakdown. Assist with expense tracking and adherence to event budgets and funding requirements.
* Provide administrative support for recruitment, including application distribution, interview coordination, candidate communications, and recordkeeping. Assist with onboarding, offboarding, and preparing documentation for visitors and other non-tenured appointments.
* Process purchases, payment requests, and reimbursements; reconcile P-Card transactions; maintain records; and assist with billing and purchasing issues.
* Maintain spreadsheets, administrative tracking tools, records, and internal webpages, ensuring accuracy and timely updates.
Perform other administrative and operational support duties as assigned by the Staff Operations & Strategic Initiatives Lead.  

  
  
**Basic Qualifications**  
  
If you have the following in your background, then we want to hear about your interest in joining our team:  

* Three years of relevant administrative or office support experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint, and experience using Google Workspace or similar collaboration tools.
* Strong organizational, communication, and customer service skills, with the ability to interact professionally and effectively with a diverse range of staff, visitors, and external contacts.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities, maintain accurate records, meet deadlines, exercise appropriate discretion with confidential information, and work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Beyond the basic qualifications, the following skills and experience may enhance your ability to contribute to the Administrative Operations Assistant role. These qualifications are preferred, but not required:  

* Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience in office administration, operations, event coordination, or a related support function.
* Experience supporting recruitment, onboarding, Human Resources, or other personnel-related administrative processes.
* Experience working at Caltech, JPL, or within an academic, scientific, or research environment.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively as part of a team, exercise sound judgment, and identify practical solutions to day-to-day administrative needs.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with experience working effectively with individuals from a variety of professional and cultural backgrounds.

  
**Required Documents**  

* Resume
* Cover letter (limited to 1 page) detailing your relevant office, administrative, and event experience, and your motivation for joining our team. Applications without a cover letter will not be considered.
* Application Deadline: November 13, 2026.

  
**Application Details**  

* This is an on-site position at the Caltech campus in Pasadena, California. Remote work is typically allowed 1 day per week after training.
* Position will require occasional evening or weekend availability in support of conferences and special events.
* Expected start by late November to mid-De

jobs.title: Program Coordinator- Oakland, CA
jobs.description:
Cross Country is looking for top talent to join our team! We are a market-leading, tech-enabled workforce solutions and advisory firm with more than four decades of experience helping organizations solve complex labor and operational challenges. Recognized as a Top Place to Work by U.S. News & World Report and a Most Loved Workplace by Newsweek, Cross Country is committed to quality and excellence in everything we deliver. We were also the first public company to earn The Joint Commission Gold Seal of Approval® for Health Care Staffing Services Certification with Distinction — a standard we continue to uphold today.
  
  
**BASIC PURPOSE:**  
The Program Coordinator provides operational, administrative, and customer support to ensure the effective delivery of homecare services for PACE programs. This role focuses on supporting caregivers (HCPs), clients, and internal teams by managing onboarding/offboarding, compliance tracking, communication, and client relations. The Program Coordinator plays a vital role in ensuring caregivers are prepared and supported, client needs are met, and all processes remain compliant and efficient.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**  
1. Assist caregivers with onboarding, orientation, credentialing, and system access.
  
2. Provide ongoing support to field staff by addressing questions, resolving issues, and ensuring they have the resources needed for successful assignments.
  
3. Maintain accurate and current records of caregiver credentials, certifications, and licensures.
  
4. Communicate updates, policy changes, and assignment details clearly and promptly.
  
5. Support HCPs with timekeeping, payroll, and schedule confirmations.
  
1. Manage HCP timekeeping issues (e.g., missed punches, errors) and review timecards for processing to ensure accuracy and time corrections in a timely manager to avoid payment errors.
  
1. Serve as a primary contact for PACE program clients, addressing inquiries and concerns promptly and professionally.
  
2. Build and maintain positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure service satisfaction.
  
3. Conduct periodic client satisfaction checks and follow up on feedback to improve service delivery.
  
4. Ensure client-specific requirements, policies, and procedures are accurately documented and shared with caregivers.
  
5. Work with Compliance team to ensure caregiver are compliant with all regulatory, licensing, and agency standards.
  
6. Maintain and update databases, internal systems, and client portals with accurate caregiver and client information.
  
7. Support audits by ensuring complete and accurate documentation is available when needed.
  
8. Generate, prepare, and distribute reports for internal teams and client review.
  
9. Assist with creating confirmation letters, client-facing communications, and process documentation.
  
10. Act as a liaison between caregivers, clients, and internal departments to ensure alignment and issue resolution.
  
11. Communicate clearly and consistently with all stakeholders to ensure smooth service delivery.
  
12. Provide backup coverage for colleagues to ensure uninterrupted clients and caregiver support.
  
13. Represent Cross Country Healthcare with professionalism and integrity in all interactions.
  
14. May be required to attend offsite job fairs and community events as needed.
  
15. May be required to provide after-hours, weekend, and holiday coverage based on business needs, ensuring timely coordination of staffing and effective communication with PACE program partners to maintain continuity of care.
  
16. Other duties as assigned
  
  
**QUALIFICATIONS:**  
1. Minimum of one (1) year of administrative or client support experience, preferably in healthcare or staffing.
  
2. Strong organizational and time management skills with ability to handle multiple priorities.
  
3. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  
4. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
  
5. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards.
  
6. Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism in all situations.
  
7. Experience with VMS technology or client portals.
  
8. Bilingual skills preferred.
  
9. Strong problem-solving and relationship-building abilities.
  
**Education:** High School Diploma or equivalent required; Some college preferred.
  
  
Company equipment(laptop, monitor, keyboard, mouse headset) will be provided directly to you for use during employment.
  
  
Benefits
  
  
Cross Country offers a competitive compensation, benefits, and wellness program, including Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Voluntary Insurance, 401(k) plan, Tuition Assistance, and Pet Insurance. The company offers a variety of Wellness options through Burnalong, which offers a robust online platform of classes and programs as well as local gym access.
  
  
Cross Country is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) - Veteran/Disability

jobs.title: Temporary Prevention Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
***Full-time, Temporary Position***

***Position Status:*** *This is a full-time, temporary position through December 31, 2026, with the potential for extension or transition to a permanent position based on program needs and funding availability. Extension or transition to permanent status is not guaranteed.*

Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco, Inc. (Horizons), established in 1965, is a community-based organization located in the Mission District and offers substance use prevention and early intervention, employment/workforce development, mental health and wellness, multimedia arts, and gender-affirming services, to Latine and all youth of color, up to age 24, and their families residing in the Mission District and throughout San Francisco.

Our programs help young people understand the systems that create inequality and how those systems affect their lives. We create safe spaces where they can make sense of their experiences, build healthy coping skills, and find their own power within these systems. Young people leave with the tools to take care of themselves and their communities and to create real change on their own terms.

**Position Title:** Principal Program Coordinator (Coordinator)

**Reports To**: Prevention Program Manager

**Program Description:** The Prevention Education Program is a comprehensive substance use prevention program that includes 3 core interventions: Communities Mobilizing for Change on Alcoholism (CMCA), Strengthening Families Program (SFP), Botvin LifeSkills Program (LST) and outreach activities.

**Position Description:** The Coordinator will be trained and responsible for facilitating groups for the 3 core interventions (CMCA, LST, SFP) according to the contract requirements and program needs. Key duties and responsibilities include outreach and recruitment, group facilitation, family engagement, data collection, reporting, etc. As part of the Prevention Team and work with the CMCA groups, the Coordinator will also participate in the COUN-SEL Coalition meetings and events as well as contribute broader prevention efforts as assigned.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Develop outreach materials and conduct outreach and recruitment for the Strengthening Families Program, with a focus on engaging African American/Black and Spanish-speaking families, as well as for Botvin LifeSkills, CMCA, and other Prevention services.
* Coordination of service provision for each intervention.
* Schedule, plan, and conduct participant orientations for admission and enrollment.
* Co-facilitate the Parent/Youth/Family components of the Strengthening Families program.
* Facilitate and lead Botvin Lifeskills program and CMCA cohorts onsite or at local school sites.
* Maintain youth files for all program participants, each cycle, as needed.
* Maintain detailed records of program attendance/services for reporting and submit monthly reports.
* Enter program services data into a tracking sheet within 24 hrs of activity.
* Reconcile data on a regular basis to ensure accuracy.
* Attend weekly program meetings, monthly All Staff meetings, and other meetings including funding source meetings.
* Maintain a programmatic budget.
* Implement program evaluations to measure the impact of delivery of services (i.e client satisfaction surveys, pre and post tests, etc.).
* Complete mandatory state compliance and other training.
* Support agency wide efforts which includes participation in 1-2 community wide committees/collectives that support the overall program mission and organizational values.
* Other duties assigned by the Prevention Program Manager.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree in social sciences or related field and/or 2+ years experience providing direct services for youth.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively facilitate youth groups.
* Commitment to learn environmental prevention work.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to meet deadlines and juggle multiple competing deadlines/tasks in a fast paced environment.
* Able to maintain confidential, accurate, and complete records including documentation of daily attendance, hours tracking. monthly and quarterly reports, etc.
* Experience using Zoom, Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Classroom, etc.), Canva, Adobe Acrobat, and other relevant software.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Job Requirements:**

* Must be able to work evenings, on weekends, and before normal business hours (10:00am-6:30pm or 12-8:30 on SFP Program evenings) for events, outreach, and training.
* Must clear a TB test before the first day of employment and annually.
* Commitment to complete all required annual training, including environmental prevention training.
* If in recovery, must be clean and sober for a minimum of 2 years.
* If the position becomes permanent, it will become subject to the SEIU Local 1021 Collective Bargaining Agreement, and the employee will be required to enroll in accordance with the applicable agreement.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* As a temporary position, this position is not eligible for Horizons’ health, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits, except for benefits required by applicable law.
* **If the position becomes permanent, the employee will become eligible for Horizons’ benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life, and AD&D insurance, effective on the first of the month following one full month of continuous employment, as well as paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and professional development opportunities, subject to applicable eligibility requirements.**
* Hourly wages range from $28.37 to $29.22.

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager, Speaker Programs
jobs.description:
### **The Position**

**Who We Are**

Strategic Event Services brings together strategy, operational excellence, technology, and cross-functional expertise to deliver high-quality experiences across congresses, speaker programs, and advisory boards.

Our team works closely with Field, Marketing, Medical, Compliance, Legal, technology teams, speakers, and vendors. The Event Operations Manager reports to the Head of Strategic Event Services The role provides essential operational, compliance, financial, and administrative support, enabling smooth, compliant execution across a high volume of programs each year.

We are looking for an Event Operations Manager who can provide end-to-end operational excellence while helping Strategic Event Services strengthen and continuously improve how speaker programs are delivered.

**The Opportunity**

The Event Operations Manager, Speaker Programs is the internal operational owner for assigned speaker bureaus and programs, from bureau setup through program closeout. You will support HCP programs (in-person, virtual), Patient programs, and HCP and Patient product theaters, most organized into brand bureaus that run on a calendar-year cycle.

Our speaker program vendor manages day-to-day logistics and execution. You will direct that vendor, keep every program inside the compliance guardrails, and own the approval, financial, and documentation work that stays in-house.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Oversee Vendor Execution:** Direct the day-to-day work of our speaker program vendor across logistics, registration, attendee management, and speaker coordination. Set clear expectations, monitor performance against SLAs and KPIs, and resolve or escalate gaps.
* **Manage Bureau and Program Operations:** Coordinate annual bureau setup and close, program intake, timelines, and readiness. Adapt requirements to each program type, including Patient program needs such as patient speaker training, privacy, and adverse event reporting.
* **Operationalize Compliance:** Partner with Compliance and Legal to confirm speaker contracting, fair market value, and training are complete before programs proceed, and that attendee, venue, meal, and state-specific rules are met.
* **Manage Materials and Approvals:** Route speaker decks, invitations, and program materials through Commercial and Medical review. Track re-approvals and expirations so only current approved materials are in use.
* **Manage Financial Operations:** Support budgets, statements of work, purchase orders, invoices, accruals, and reconciliation. Validate speaker honoraria and HCP spend for Open Payments (Sunshine Act) and state transparency reporting.
* **Coordinate Across Functions:** Partner with the Marketing, Field, Medical, Compliance, and Finance, to resolve dependencies and provide visibility into progress and risks. Serve as an operational resource for field teams, and bring platform and data needs to the product team.
* **Report and Improve:** Work with our vendor to maintain trackers and standard reports on program activity, speaker utilization, exceptions, and vendor performance. Work with the product team to simplify and automate high-volume work and strengthen SOPs.

**Who You Are**

* You have a Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* You have at least 4 years of experience in event operations, speaker program operations, project management, commercial operations, or a related field.
* Experience managing vendors that deliver high-volume programs or events, including tracking deliverables and resolving issues through appropriate escalation.
* Working knowledge of the rules governing interactions with healthcare professionals, such as the PhRMA Code, Anti-Kickback Statute, OIG guidance on speaker programs, and Open Payments (Sunshine Act) reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to manage many concurrent programs with strong organization and attention to detail.
* Experience supporting structured Commercial, Medical, regulatory, or other content-review and approval processes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, including intermediate Excel, and the ability to learn program-management, content-management, and workflow platforms.
* Willingness to travel occasionally based on program needs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting speaker programs or HCP engagement in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare industry.
* Experience supporting patient-facing programs, patient speakers, or patient advocacy engagement.
* Experience managing program exceptions, compliance documentation, or supporting audits and monitoring.
* Experience with vendor speaker portals, Veeva, Cvent, Jira, or comparable tools.
* Experience managing purchase orders, invoices, program budgets, spend reconciliation, and transparency reporting data.

This role requires an onsite presence at our South San Francisco, Genentech Campus.

Relocation benefits are **NOT** offered on this posting

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of South San Francisco, CA is $100,700/yr to $186,900/yr. **Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law**. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

***Why Lucky Strike?***

We Are Lucky Strike Entertainment, one of the largest and most successful location-based entertainment companies in the World with 360 upscale and traditional Bowling Centers, five expansive and well-located Waterparks, a large Amusement Park in California and 10 upscale Boomers Family Entertainment Centers in major markets.

From a humble beginning with one bowling center in 1997, we redefined an industry and built a powerhouse Company with 14,000 Associates and nearly $1.4 billion in annual revenue. Hospitality is our core and we strive to deliver memorable experiences for every guest on every visit.

When you join Lucky Strike, you join a team of passionate winners and give yourself the best opportunity for sustained career growth and opportunity. It’s not easy to get hired by us – we want only the most talented and committed Managers, but when you do join Lucky Strike, the rewards are abundant.

* Execute events from setup through breakdown, leading your team to deliver seamless, memorable group experiences

jobs.description:
About Altais:

At Altais, we’re on a mission to improve the healthcare experience for everyone—starting with the people who deliver it. We believe physicians should spend more time with patients and less time on administrative tasks. Through smarter technology, purpose-built tools, and a team-based model of care, we help doctors do what they do best: care for people.

Altais includes a network of physician-led organizations across California, including Brown & Toland Physicians, Altais Medical Group Riverside, and Family Care Specialists. Together, we’re building a stronger, more connected healthcare system.

**About the Role**

**Are you looking to join a fast-growing, dynamic team?**

We’re a collaborative, purpose-driven group that’s passionate about transforming healthcare from the inside out. At Altais, we support one another, adapt quickly, and work with integrity as we build a better experience for physicians and their patients.

The Network Development Coordinator supports the Network Development Manager in executing initiatives related to provider recruitment, onboarding, and engagement across Altais’s Networks of Care (including Brown & Toland Physicians, Altais Care Network, and Family Care Specialist IPA).

This role is responsible for coordinating outreach efforts, supporting onboarding processes, maintaining provider data, and assisting with relationship management activities to ensure a smooth and efficient experience for prospective and newly contracted providers. The Coordinator plays a key role in operational execution, process support, and cross-functional coordination.

**Candidates considered for this role must live in California.**

**You will focus on:**

**Provider Recruitment Support:**

Assist in identifying prospective physicians and providers by conducting research, maintaining lead lists, and supporting outreach efforts. Coordinate initial communications and schedule meetings for the Network Development Manager.

**Provider Onboarding Coordination:**

Support the onboarding process for new providers by coordinating documentation, tracking onboarding steps, and partnering with internal teams (e.g., credentialing, contracting) to ensure timely completion of requirements.

**Provider Engagement Support:**

Assist in maintaining relationships with prospective and newly onboarded providers by coordinating follow-ups, responding to basic inquiries, and escalating issues to the Network Development Manager as needed.

**Presentation & Event Coordination:**

Support preparation of presentation materials, proposals, and outreach content. Coordinate logistics for meetings, events, and presentations (in-person and virtual), including scheduling, materials, and follow-up communication.

**Market & Data Support:**

Conduct basic market research and maintain tracking tools related to provider outreach, recruitment pipelines, and network development activities. Compile data and assist in reporting for leadership review.

**Service & Program Knowledge:**

Maintain working knowledge of organizational services and provider offerings to support accurate communication and coordination efforts.

**Cross-Functional Coordination:**

Partner with internal teams (marketing, physician relations, operations) to support outreach campaigns, communications, and onboarding activities. Assist in coordinating provider-facing initiatives such as events, mailings, and meetings.

**Travel Support:**

Participate in occasional travel within California to support provider meetings, events, or onboarding activities, as needed.

You will own coordination from listing preparation through closing and execute consistent, polished marketing and social media.

Compensation: Up to $100,000 per year for full-time employment, depending on experience and qualifications, plus bonus. Part-time compensation will be prorated based on agreed hours.

Location: Menlo Park, CA. Local in-person availability is required for property preparation, vendor appointments, and listing needs.

TRANSACTION COORDINATION

* Manage files from executed contract through closing, track deadlines, and follow up independently on outstanding items.

* Review paperwork for accurate names, dates, signatures, initials, and completeness before sending for review or signatures.

* Coordinate with clients, agents, escrow, title, inspectors, and lenders; flag issues early with proposed next steps.

LISTING COORDINATION

* Own listing preparation schedules and launch checklists.

* Prepare and organize disclosure packages and listing documents; coordinate accurate MLS entries and updates under agent direction.

MARKETING AND SOCIAL MEDIA

* Create polished brochures, email campaigns, property website updates, and just-listed, open-house, and just-sold materials.

* Maintain a social media content calendar; draft captions, create branded posts and stories, edit simple reels, and schedule approved content.

* Turn the lead agent's market insights and listing content into consistent marketing, coordinating with photographers, videographers, and outside designers.

* Proofread every asset for accurate property information, spelling, links, branding, and required brokerage disclosures.

QUALIFICATIONS

* Proven California residential transaction coordination experience, with strong knowledge of contracts, disclosures, deadlines, and brokerage workflows.

* Active California real estate license required.

* Demonstrated listing coordination experience and ability to manage several properties and transactions at once.

* Excellent responsiveness, attention to detail, written communication, judgment, and follow-through.

* Comfortable with MLS, electronic signatures, disclosure tools, Google Workspace, Canva, and social media scheduling tools.

* Ability to show examples of polished real estate marketing and social media work.

* Peninsula market experience and experience supporting a busy luxury real estate agent are preferred.

* Able to travel locally to properties throughout the service area.

TO APPLY

Submit your resume, preferred full-time or part-time schedule, and a brief note describing your transaction coordination experience, current Side approval status, and listing and marketing responsibilities. Include examples or links to social media or marketing work you created. Finalists may be asked to complete a practical work sample and provide professional references.

We value ownership, accuracy, discretion, clear communication, and a positive, solutions-focused approach.

Pay: Up to $100,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - West
jobs.description:
Apnimed is a rapidly growing pharmaceutical company working to transform the treatment of sleep apnea based on a simple idea – patients with obstructive sleep apnea could benefit from treatment with a safe and effective oral medication dosed once daily at bedtime. Our lead development program targets the neurologic control of upper airway muscles to maintain an open airway during sleep. Based in Cambridge, Mass., Apnimed is committed to innovation, as well as state-of-the-art advancements in sleep medicine, which is leading to the development of a portfolio of novel pharmacologic therapies for sleep apnea and related disorders. Of note, the Boston Business Journal has also voted Apnimed as one of the Best Places to Work in 2024 and 2025!  
  
The Key Account Manager (KAM) will play a pivotal role in securing access and driving adoption of AD109 within the nation’s largest health systems and integrated delivery networks. Reporting to the National Sales Director, this senior field-based role owns a defined book of strategic accounts, engaging system-level clinical, pharmacy and administrative decision makers to establish formulary access, influence treatment protocols and pathways, and unlock the sleep and pulmonology centers within each system.  
  
This is a highly visible, entrepreneurial role requiring a strategic account planner with deep experience selling into complex health systems and navigating committee-driven decision making. The KAM carries no direct reports but leads a matrixed account team, including Regional Sales Leaders and sales specialists, Market Access, Medical Affairs and Marketing, to deliver one coordinated plan per account.  
  
**Key Job Duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Own a defined portfolio of strategic health systems and integrated delivery networks, mapping the decision-making structure of each and executing an account plan spanning pre-launch preparation, launch execution and post launch growth
* Map and build relationships across all relevant stakeholders within an account, including physicians, clinical staff, pharmacy, administration, and other decision-influencers.
* Partner with Market Access to pull through national and regional payer coverage at the system level
* Influence system treatment protocols, order sets, care pathways and referral flows to support identification and treatment of patients with obstructive sleep apnea
* Lead pre-launch and launch-readiness activities within assigned key accounts, including stakeholder mapping and understanding of patient journey
* Lead the matrixed account team without direct authority, aligning field sales, Market Access, Medical Affairs and Marketing behind one coordinated plan per account
* Identify and support system-level screening, diagnostic and care coordination initiatives that expand appropriate patient identification
* Establish account-level KPIs to measure access, adoption and pull-through, and surface system trends, access barriers and competitive intelligence to commercial leadership
* Ensure all account activity is conducted in full compliance with company policy, industry codes and applicable regulations

**Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of biopharmaceutical commercial experience, including 3+ years in key account management, health system or institutional selling
* Demonstrated success securing formulary access and driving protocol or pathway change within large health systems and integrated delivery networks
* Proven track record of successful product launches, ideally in specialty or CNS-related markets
* Strong working knowledge of health system economics, reimbursement, specialty pharmacy and utilization management
* Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority
* Strong strategic account planning skills with the ability to execute tactically in a fast-paced environment
* Excellent communication, executive presence and stakeholder management skills
* Field-based role; must reside within the assigned geography and be able to travel extensively, including overnight travel
* Valid driver’s license and an acceptable driving record
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, PharmD, or similar) preferred

**What Apnimed Offers:**

* 401(k) with company match
* Generous time off for vacation
* Generous Company paid benefits
* Flexible working environment
* Motivated and experienced team

**Location and Other Information:**

* This is a field-based role; the KAM must reside within the assigned geography.
* Apnimed is an EEO employer committed to an exciting, diverse, and enriching work environment.
* The annual base salary range for this position is $172,000 - $220,000.
* Please visit us at www.apnimed.com to learn more about our work with Obstructive Sleep Apnea

===================

Distyl is an applied AI technology company partnering with the world’s most ambitious institutions to rearchitect critical operations for the frontier of AI. Our customers include the largest companies in telecom, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, consumer goods, and global social organizations.  
  
We research and deploy technologies that power AI-native operations — both for our partners and for Distyl itself. Our work spans research into self-constructing systems, the development of the most reliable execution of AI systems, and products that transform mission-critical workflows. As a result, Distyl's technologies affect some of the world's largest operations — from hundreds of millions of consumer interactions to tens of millions of supply chain transactions and millions of patient journeys.  
  
Distyl is backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Coatue, DST Global, and the board-members of 20+ F500s.

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

As we scale, we need someone who can keep both our hiring engine and our employee experience running smoothly. This is a hybrid role: roughly half recruiting coordination and half People Operations. You will own interview logistics and the candidate experience on one side, and onboarding, benefits coordination, and core HR administration on the other.

You will be the connective tissue between candidates, new hires, and the teams they join. You will partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and the People team, and you will keep finding ways to make our processes faster and better using AI tools. This is an ideal first or second step into a generalist People career for someone who wants real ownership and exposure to both talent and people operations at a fast-growing company.

**Recruiting Coordination (~50%)**

* Act as the primary point of contact for candidates, communicating with a warm, informative tone that makes every touchpoint feel considered
* Coordinate availability across candidates, interviewers, hiring managers, and leadership, including onsite and virtual interviews, panel prep, and debrief scheduling
* Proactively flag scheduling conflicts and pipeline bottlenecks before they become delays
* Maintain accurate candidate data and pipeline hygiene in Ashby

**People Operations (~50%)**

**Across Both Areas**

* Identify opportunities to use AI tools to streamline scheduling, communication, onboarding, and reporting, and help build and implement those improvements
* Suggest and drive improvements to our recruiting and People processes, especially in ambiguous or undefined situations
* Handle confidential candidate and employee information with care and good judgment

**Who You Are**
===============

* **Experience in Recruiting or People Ops:** 1 - 3 years of experience as a Recruiting Coordinator, People Operations Coordinator, HR Coordinator, or in a similar role, ideally at a startup or tech company. Strong internship experience combined with exceptional ownership will also be considered
* **Organized and Detail-Oriented:** Manage many moving pieces, from interview loops to new hire checklists, without dropping details
* **Candidate and Employee-First Mentality:** Treat every interaction, whether with a candidate or a brand-new hire, as a chance to make someone feel supported
* **Strong Written and Verbal Communication:** Write clear, friendly emails that build rapport and keep every stakeholder informed

* **AI-Native Working Style:** Use AI tools regularly to streamline your work, and you are excited to find new ways to apply them
* **Bias Towards Process Improvement:** Notice where a workflow is inefficient and take the initiative to fix it, rather than just working around it
* **Comfort with Ambiguity:** Work across two functions and many stakeholders at once, even when the process isn’t fully defined yet
* **Nice to have:** Experience with Ashby or a similar ATS, and Rippling or a similar HRIS and benefits platforms, and exposure to US employment basics (onboarding compliance, benefits enrollment cycles)

=================
