jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE:** HBCI Program Coordinator

**REPORTS TO:** HBCI Program Supervisor

**DEPARTMENT**: HBCI (Home Based Crisis Intervention Program)

**JOB TYPE:** Part Time, 21 hours per week

**OBJECTIVES:** Reporting to the HBCI Program Supervisor, the part-time HBCI Coordinator supports the delivery of high-quality, family-centered, home-based crisis intervention services for youth and families by providing clinical supervision, staff support, program oversight, and regulatory compliance monitoring. The HBCI Program Coordinator collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective service delivery, adherence to OMH and agency standards, and the achievement of program goals and outcomes while promoting best practices in behavioral health care.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**:

* Works closely with the HBCI Program Supervisor to ensure all HBCI program requirements are met.

* Collaborate with the HBCI Program Supervisor in the development and implementation of program goals, objectives, and strategies.

* Supervises Interventionists who provide on-site and crisis-based intervention services to high-risk youth and their families.

* Accompany HBCI staff on initial home visits and provide coverage for visits when staff are unavailable or out of the office.

* Monitors the productivity and performance of HBCI Interventionists to ensure delivery of high-quality services.

* Reviews staff documentation in the Electronic Health Record (EHR) system to ensure timely, accurate, and complete recordkeeping.

* Ensures compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements, including those established by OMH and DOHMH.

* Provides 24-hour on-call coverage for the HBCI program, as assigned.

* Collaborates with the Director of Behavioral Health/Clinic, Assistant Directors, Program Coordinators, Intake Department, and Quality Assurance team to deliver best-practice clinical services in compliance with OMH regulations.

* Attends agency, community, and external meetings and events as required.

* Performs other duties as assigned by the HBCI Program Supervisor and/or the Director of Behavioral Health.

**SPECIFIC SKILLS**:

* Knowledge and experience utilizing evidence-based treatment models and interventions.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain collaborative working relationships.
* Ability to present program services and information to community organizations and stakeholders.
* Demonstrated cultural competence, humility, and sensitivity when working with diverse populations.

**QUALIFICATIONS**:

* LMSW/ LCSW or LMHC with a current New York State License.
* Minimum of two (2) years of experience working with children, adolescents, or young adults experiencing acute mental health crises.
* Experience providing services to youth and families impacted by behavioral health challenges.
* Experience delivering home-based services and willingness to travel to clients’ homes.
* Experience providing clinical supervision to staff, SIFI training preferred.
* Bilingual Spanish-speaking skills preferred.

**COMPENSATION: $35 per hour, 21 hours per week**

**About Northside**

Northside Center for Child Development serves more than 5,500 children and families across New York City each year through high-quality, outcome-driven behavioral health, early childhood education, and enrichment services. With over $34 million in annual funding, Northside provides the comprehensive support children and families need to overcome adversity, build resilience, and pursue their dreams.

Founded in 1946 in Harlem, Northside has been a cornerstone of the community for eight decades, leading the way in integrating education and mental health to support children’s development. Several of Northside’s innovative programs were the first of their kind in Harlem, setting standards of care that continue to influence social service agencies throughout the United States today.

Northside’s founders, Drs. Kenneth B. and Mamie Phipps Clark, were renowned, pioneering psychologists whose groundbreaking research was instrumental in the 1954 Brown v. Board of Education landmark Supreme Court decision that declared school segregation unconstitutional. Their belief in the worth, dignity, and potential of every child continues to guide Northside’s mission and inspire its work today. Northside is driven by its vision and principle, “Each Child…First Chance.”

For more information on Northside Center for Child Development, please visit www.northsidecenter.org.

jobs.description:
**Organizational Background**

City Living NY (CLNY) empowers youth aging out of foster care across New York City to transition successfully by providing essential resources and in-depth support. Initially, we identify the home goods and furnishings they need to turn their first apartments into homes, and maintain contact with them for two years to ensure housing stability. These youth are also eligible for our more intensive Core Program where they work with their assigned social worker to identify their goals and receive support around a wide range of issues including educational, employment, financial, social-emotional, and parenting. We stay with our clients through these critical first years and provide the stability and resources so many do not have. When foster care ends, our work begins.

**About the Position:** Reporting to the Alumni Program Supervisor, the Alumni Program Coordinator is responsible for supporting the day-to-day operations of the Alumni Program. The Alumni Program Coordinator will collaborate with the Alumni Program Supervisor to innovate on existing programming, and lead development on new offerings. With guidance from their supervisor, the Alumni Program Coordinator will also partner directly with alumni to provide support in areas like housing, employment, education and crisis management.

**Responsibilities**

*Case Management (70% of time)*

* Provide ongoing case management, supportive counseling, and crisis intervention services to alumni participants.
* Assist alumni in accessing housing, employment, education, healthcare, and mental health resources.
* Perform home and community visits, as needed.
* Provide referrals to appropriate agencies/ organizations and accompany clients to appointments as needed.
* Maintain case records and documentation in accordance with agency standards.

*Program Operations (30% of time)*

* Co-plan and execute alumni workshops and the annual Alumni Community Event.
* Coordinate emergency grant initiatives, including the Rent Matching Program.
* Gather feedback from the Alumni Advisory Board and coordinate the implementation of recommendations to enhance program offerings and alumni engagement.
* Participate in weekly team meetings and collaboration efforts.
* Represent the alumni program at agency, community, and partner meetings.
* Track program outcomes and prepare reports as requested by the Executive Director.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned by Alumni Program Supervisor, Program Director and Executive Director.

**Qualifications**

*Experience*

* Bachelor's degree required; Bachelor of Social Work (BSW) preferred.
* Minimum of one year working with at-risk teens and young adults and/or in child welfare (or equivalent experience preferred).
* Experience navigating complex social service, educational, and other systems, particularly those serving young adults in NYC.
* Experience in coaching and empowering individuals.

*Skills and Interests*

* A self-starter and creative problem solver who takes initiative and demonstrates flexibility in response to continually changing situations
* Ability to work independently, with excellent organizational skills and maintain detailed and up-to-date records
* Ability to flex hours and conduct home visits/phone contacts on evenings and/or weekends as needed to accommodate client schedules
* Candidates with lived experience in foster care, housing instability, or related systems are strongly encouraged to apply
* A genuine interest in CLNY’s mission of supporting young adults aging out of the foster care system transition successfully into adulthood
* Bilingual Spanish/English a plus

Our sales professionals have a major impact on our business as they develop and implement the projections, forecasts and long-range planning strategies that will fuel our success today and into the future. A career in sales puts you alongside talented people working cross-functionally throughout our organization. The challenges are exciting, the pace is fast, and you’ll have a chance to build a career of almost limitless possibilities.

The **Associate Account Executive/Sales Operations** will support the Robert Graham Wholesale business by managing customer service, account setup, order fulfillment, shipping communication, NuOrder, and day-to-day sales administration. This role will serve as a key liaison between key and specialty accounts, the sales team, distribution, credit, planning, and other internal partners to help ensure accounts are properly onboarded, orders are processed accurately, and shipments are completed on time.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, responsive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple accounts, reps and priorities in a fast-paced wholesale environment. This position will play an important role in providing a high level of service to our customers while improving visibility, follow-through, and operational efficiency across the business.

**Customer Service and Order Management**

* Serve as the primary operational contact for Specialty Store accounts regarding order status, shipping, inventory availability, and delivery questions.

* Process order revisions, cancellations, extensions, substitutions, and other customer requests.
* Coordinate returns, return authorizations, shortages, damages, chargebacks, and shipping claims as needed.
* Maintain customer-specific compliance requirements.

**Account Setup and Maintenance**

* Manage the setup and onboarding of new accounts from initial request through account activation.
* Collect and review credit applications, resale certificates, payment information, shipping instructions, routing requirements, and other required documentation.
* Coordinate with Credit, Finance, Customer Service, and other internal teams to ensure accounts are approved, activated and maintained promptly.
* Maintain accurate customer records, contact information, payment terms, shipping instructions, sales representative assignments, and account notes.
* Communicate account-setup status, outstanding requirements, and approvals to customers and the sales team.
* Support updates to existing accounts, including ownership, billing, shipping, contact, and credit-information changes.

**NuOrder Management**

* Manage the day-to-day administration of NuOrder for the wholesale business.
* Set up and maintain customer and sales representative access, account assignments, territories, and permissions.
* Review NuOrder orders for accuracy and coordinate their entry or integration into the order-management system.
* Troubleshoot customer and sales representative questions related to login access, product visibility, order placement, and platform functionality.
* Monitor NuOrder activity and follow up on incomplete orders, draft orders, and other sales opportunities.
* Ensure product, pricing, inventory, and account information remain accurate and current within the platform.
* Coordinate with internal teams and NuOrder support to resolve platform or integration issues.

**Specialty Sales Support**

* Provide day-to-day back-office support for the Specialty Stores sales team and outside sales representatives.
* Submit, review, and maintain wholesale orders in the order-management system.
* Prepare order confirmations, open-order reports, shipping recaps, ATS reports, and other sales materials.
* Help manage order deadlines, shipping windows, and follow-up calendars.
* Coordinate sample and collateral requests for specialty accounts and sales representatives.

**Reporting and Business Coordination**

* Maintain regular reporting on bookings, open orders, shipments, cancellations, returns, and account status.
* Identify order or shipping issues that could affect revenue and escalate them to sales leadership.
* Track specialty-account performance and provide information needed for sales recaps and business reviews.
* Work cross-functionally with Sales, Planning, Allocation, Credit, Finance, Production, Distribution, and Customer Service.
* Support the development and improvement of sales-operation processes, reporting tools, and account-service standards.
* Complete additional sales administration projects as needed.

Our Best Fit Candidate Would Have::

* 2–4 years of experience in sales operations, wholesale cust

jobs.title: Account Manager, Communications and Technology
jobs.description:
*Please Note: This role requires the ability to work on site 3 days per*

*week per company policy.*

The annual salary range for this role in New York is $105,000-$120,000.

The World Economic Forum, committed to improving the state of the world, is the international organization for public-private cooperation. The Forum engages the foremost political, business and other leaders of society to shape global, regional and industry agendas.

**Why we are recruiting**

As a partnership organization and through the Business Engagement teams, the World Economic Forum engages the private sector to address industry, regional and systemic issues. Partners benefit from and contribute to the global knowledge base through working closely with the Forum to set the intellectual agenda of Forum gatherings, drive the insight agenda of its publications and steer the impact of its initiatives.

Structured geographically, the Global Industries Team is responsible for building and managing the world’s premier communities of business executives.

We are currently seeking an Account Manager (internal title Senior Account Associate, Communication and Technology Industries), who will be tasked to manage a portfolio of Partner accounts and engage relevant executives in the Forum’s events, initiatives and communities. The role will serve as the primary point of contact for assigned organizations; develop and implement tailored engagement strategies plans that strengthen relationships with CEOs and C-suite executives and identify opportunities to strengthen the engagement with the Forum.

  

The portfolio is primarily composed of high-growth companies shaping the next generation of technology, business models, and critical infrastructure, and are increasingly looking to engage with global business, government, and civil society leaders on issues of systemic importance.

**Reporting Lines and Interactions**

The role will interact with our partners, and across multiple teams ranging from Finance, Contract Management to Industry, Centre and Government engagement groups. The person will report to the Senior Manager, Communications and Technology.

**Main** **responsibilities**

* **Partner relationship management**: Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior Partner representatives; lead regular engagement with Partners to understand their strategic priorities; collaborate with relevant internal stakeholders to deliver a seamless Partner experience. Engage partners in relevant industry work.
* **Portfolio growth and account management**: Monitor Partner engagement, business developments and overall account health to identify opportunities for partnership growth and expansion; proactively identify partnership risks and develop retention strategies in collaboration with the Head of Industry to maximize long-term Partner value.
* **Partner engagement and event strategy:** Develop tailored engagement plans strategies for Partners; shape executive agendas identify relevant opportunities for executive participation, speaking roles and leadership interactions and ensure effective follow-up to maximize engagement outcomes.
* **Cross-functional collaboration**: Work closely with Industry, Regional, Centre, Event, Finance and Partner Development teams to coordinate Partner activities; provide strategic guidance to Account Associates on operational delivery and ensure high-quality execution across the Partner lifecycle.

**Success in this role will be measured by:**

* **Partner engagement**: Strong and trusted relationships with senior executives, reflected in sustained engagement across Forum activities.
* **Partner retention**: High retention rates and proactive management of at-risk accounts through effective engagement strategies.
* **Cross-functional delivery Collaboration and leadership**: Effective coordination across internal teams, enabling a seamless Partner experience and consistent knowledge sharing.

**Preferred Requirements and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Business, Economics, Management or another relevant field.
* Knowledge and understanding of the business and political landscape of Communications and Technology companies.
* 4+ years of full-time experience in a business development or relationship management role in a fast-changing professional environment. Working knowledge and experience of sales cycle management, account management, market research is a must.
* Ability to build and maintain positive relationship with partners that enable the Forum to drive new business opportunities
* Excellent organizational, project and time management skills, a strong work ethic, and high attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with and manage expectations of senior stakeholders
* Agile team player who enjoys working in a highly collaborative, culturally diverse, fast-paced, and rapidly evolving environment.
* Deep passion for the future of the business in the emerging world, the role it plays within the global context, and its potential impact on society and the individual
* Responsible, independent, and self-driven with a learning mindset and a positive attitude
* Proficient in working with MS Office and Salesforce, experience with other CRM tools a plus.
* Proficiency in working with AI solutions – knowledge of Chat GPT and Slack a plus.

**Why join us?**

Join an independent and impartial organization with over 55 years of connecting leaders to make sense of global challenges and move the world forward together.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
***LOCATION PREFERENCE West Coast or Colorado/Mountain time!!!*** *\**  
  
HUMAN is looking for a Technical Account Manager to join a dynamic team driving the future success of our customers. You will work strategically to maximize our client's protection in real time, while focusing on the value our customers see from you and managing the complete customer lifecycle.
  
Our technology is critical to our customers; as a core member of this team, your job is to ensure flawless customer service, with empathetic engagement, technical savviness, and deep product knowledge. Your exceptional organizational skills allow you to keep many balls in the air at the same time. You will be responsible for managing the day to day relationships with your customers, surfacing risks and opportunities to the business, being the voice of the customer in our organization, and the voice of HUMAN to the customer.
  
The relationship you build with your managed customers has a direct impact on our product - both in the short and long term to ensure the needs of the client are heard and met.

**What you'll do:**

* Ensure customer satisfaction: Focus on customer satisfaction, retention, and reference-ability for all assigned accounts.
* Expand and develop client relationships: Be the primary focal point for our customers. Build and maintain deep-level partnerships with customers to foster long-term cooperation and success.
* Provide exceptional customer support and be a point of escalation: Work with support teams to deliver outstanding service to customers.
* Collaborate with internal teams: Work closely with all other teams (Sales, Tech Support, R&D, Finance, Product and executive leadership team) to ensure excellent customer experience.
* Be the voice of the customer: Proactively gather feedback on product and service and work internally to better meet customer needs.
* Educate and enable customers on our products: run enablement sessions and create materials for your customers.
* Highly motivated to quickly learn HUMAN’s products with emphasis on Enterprise Security products (Bot Defender, Code Defender, Credential Intelligence and Account Defender), the TAM role and add value to the Customer Success group.
* Lead Executive Business Reviews on a regular basis with key customers and HUMAN stakeholders, from leadership to business and technical champions to technical practitioners.

**Who you are:**

* Client-facing experience: Have 3-5 years of experience in a B2B enterprise customer facing role, with a proven track record of managing large enterprise accounts.
* Eager to learn and grow: Open-minded and committed to personal and professional development.
* Technical aptitude: Technical proficiency is important, but a willingness to learn and grow is essential.
* Accountable and self-motivated: You are eager to learn every day, own timelines, and ensure deliverables are met.
* Strong organizational and communication skills: Able to effectively manage multiple tasks and communicate clearly with customers and internal teams.
* Collaborative mindset: Work collaboratively with teams across the company. Be a team player.
* Highly motivated to quickly learn HUMAN’s products with emphasis on Enterprise Security products (Sightline), the TAM role and add value to the Customer Success team.
* Problem-solving skills: Comfortable leading and resolving complex issues, with strict attention to detail.
* Educational background: Bachelor’s or Graduate’s Degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, information systems, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience in B2B SAAS, SQL, Javascript, Kibana and other cloud and software systems is an advantage.

**About HUMAN Security**

HUMAN was founded in a Brooklyn sci-fi bookstore with a hacker mindset and the lofty mission of making the internet safer by putting humans first. Today, our Human Defense Platform safeguards enterprises from sophisticated bots, fraud, and account abuse, verifying the humanity of more than 20 trillion interactions per week for the world’s biggest brands and internet platforms.

HUMAN is an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to protecting the internet's integrity for everyone. We believe in putting people first, embracing diversity of thought from our global teams, and welcoming all individuals to share their unique experiences as we fight cybercrime together. We support our Humans with a comprehensive total rewards package for personal and professional development, including well-being and learning stipends, flexible work options, and dedicated time off. While our HQ is in NYC, we have teams worldwide.

HUMAN is growing fast, and there’s never been a more meaningful time to join us. If you thrive on solving complex problems and want to help shape the future of cybersecurity, join us as we build a safer, more human internet.

If you are an individual with a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us directly.

Compensation Range: $100K - $140K

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - East
jobs.description:
Apnimed is a rapidly growing pharmaceutical company working to transform the treatment of sleep apnea based on a simple idea – patients with obstructive sleep apnea could benefit from treatment with a safe and effective oral medication dosed once daily at bedtime. Our lead development program targets the neurologic control of upper airway muscles to maintain an open airway during sleep. Based in Cambridge, Mass., Apnimed is committed to innovation, as well as state-of-the-art advancements in sleep medicine, which is leading to the development of a portfolio of novel pharmacologic therapies for sleep apnea and related disorders. Of note, the Boston Business Journal has also voted Apnimed as one of the Best Places to Work in 2024 and 2025!  
  
The Key Account Manager (KAM) will play a pivotal role in securing access and driving adoption of AD109 within the nation’s largest health systems and integrated delivery networks. Reporting to the National Sales Director, this senior field-based role owns a defined book of strategic accounts, engaging system-level clinical, pharmacy and administrative decision makers to establish formulary access, influence treatment protocols and pathways, and unlock the sleep and pulmonology centers within each system.  
  
This is a highly visible, entrepreneurial role requiring a strategic account planner with deep experience selling into complex health systems and navigating committee-driven decision making. The KAM carries no direct reports but leads a matrixed account team, including Regional Sales Leaders and sales specialists, Market Access, Medical Affairs and Marketing, to deliver one coordinated plan per account.  
  
**Key Job Duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Own a defined portfolio of strategic health systems and integrated delivery networks, mapping the decision-making structure of each and executing an account plan spanning pre-launch preparation, launch execution and post launch growth
* Map and build relationships across all relevant stakeholders within an account, including physicians, clinical staff, pharmacy, administration, and other decision-influencers.
* Partner with Market Access to pull through national and regional payer coverage at the system level
* Influence system treatment protocols, order sets, care pathways and referral flows to support identification and treatment of patients with obstructive sleep apnea
* Lead pre-launch and launch-readiness activities within assigned key accounts, including stakeholder mapping and understanding of patient journey
* Lead the matrixed account team without direct authority, aligning field sales, Market Access, Medical Affairs and Marketing behind one coordinated plan per account
* Identify and support system-level screening, diagnostic and care coordination initiatives that expand appropriate patient identification
* Establish account-level KPIs to measure access, adoption and pull-through, and surface system trends, access barriers and competitive intelligence to commercial leadership
* Ensure all account activity is conducted in full compliance with company policy, industry codes and applicable regulations

**Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of biopharmaceutical commercial experience, including 3+ years in key account management, health system or institutional selling
* Demonstrated success securing formulary access and driving protocol or pathway change within large health systems and integrated delivery networks
* Proven track record of successful product launches, ideally in specialty or CNS-related markets
* Strong working knowledge of health system economics, reimbursement, specialty pharmacy and utilization management
* Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority
* Strong strategic account planning skills with the ability to execute tactically in a fast-paced environment
* Excellent communication, executive presence and stakeholder management skills
* Field-based role; must reside within the assigned geography and be able to travel extensively, including overnight travel
* Valid driver’s license and an acceptable driving record
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, PharmD, or similar) preferred

**What Apnimed Offers:**

* 401(k) with company match
* Generous time off for vacation
* Generous Company paid benefits
* Flexible working environment
* Motivated and experienced team

**Location and Other Information:**

* This is a field-based role; the KAM must reside within the assigned geography.
* Apnimed is an EEO employer committed to an exciting, diverse, and enriching work environment.
* The annual base salary range for this position is $172,000 - $220,000.
* Please visit us at www.apnimed.com to learn more about our work with Obstructive Sleep Apnea

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

The Project Coordinator supports locations across the Endurant Disaster Recovery network, keeping restoration and reconstruction jobs organized, documented, and moving from estimate approval through final payment. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable balancing multiple jobs, deadlines, and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment. This person serves as a key link between corporate, field operations, estimating, customers, carriers, and trade partners, and helps bring consistent coordination practices to every location.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Enter and maintain accurate job information, project dates, and weekly progress notes in the job management systems (RM, PSA) and corresponding TPA platforms

**Bright from the Start: Georgia Department of Early Care and Learning (DECAL)** is responsible for meeting the childcare and early education needs of Georgia's children and their families. It administers the nationally recognized Georgia's Pre-K Program, licenses childcare centers and home-based childcare, administers Georgia Childcare and Parent Services (CAPS) program, federal nutrition programs, and managers Quality Rated, Georgia's community powered childcare rating system.

  

The department also houses the Head Start State Collaboration Office, distributes federal funding to enhance the quality and availability of childcare, and works collaboratively with Georgia childcare resource and referral agencies and organizations throughout the state to enhance early care and education.

  

The purpose of the grant project is to develop, improve, and maintain automated information technology systems used to operate and manage all Child Nutrition (CN) Programs (i.e., Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP) and Summer Food Service Program SFSP)). The intent is to provide funding for automated systems that will improve program accountability, data accuracy, program performance, and the capacity to identify and target error-prone areas (locations or program functions) within and across the CN Programs at the State and Local Education Agency (LEA) or Sponsoring Organization (SO). **This is a time-limited grant funded position which will end on September 30, 2028.**

  

As part of DECAL’s Nutrition Services Division, the Project Coordinator will play a central role in executing this multi-year initiative (grant-funded) by coordinating project activities, tracking progress, and facilitating communication between internal teams, external vendors, and stakeholders. This position requires strong project management skills and familiarity with project management methodologies and principles. A project management professional certification (such as PMP) is preferred, as the Project Coordinator will be responsible for leading day-to-day operations under the guidance and oversight of designated project leads. This includes supporting the development of a new meal service and procurement module, managing timelines, performance metrics, and deliverables, and ensuring compliance with federal and state requirements.

  

**Job Description:**

The Project Coordinator, under the supervision of the Procurement Compliance Supervisor, will be responsible for managing the implementation of the grant proposal. Primary objectives of the grant proposal include implementing technological enhancements to the current State Agency website, application and processing system that will automate and streamline procurement requirements and meal service operations for CACFP/SFSP organizations. The position will take the lead on software research, outreach efforts, coordinating proposal projects and initiatives. This position will also work closely with DECAL’s IT representatives to collect data routinely and will offer strategic and visionary leadership related to the technology in Child Nutrition Programs (CNPs). The successful candidate will have strong organizational skills, time management, writing and interpersonal skills, attention to detail, and the ability to build strong, collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

  

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Plans, manages, and completes projects that support technology enhancements with Nutrition procurement processes and meal service operations.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Southeast
jobs.description:
Apnimed is a rapidly growing pharmaceutical company working to transform the treatment of sleep apnea based on a simple idea – patients with obstructive sleep apnea could benefit from treatment with a safe and effective oral medication dosed once daily at bedtime. Our lead development program targets the neurologic control of upper airway muscles to maintain an open airway during sleep. Based in Cambridge, Mass., Apnimed is committed to innovation, as well as state-of-the-art advancements in sleep medicine, which is leading to the development of a portfolio of novel pharmacologic therapies for sleep apnea and related disorders. Of note, the Boston Business Journal has also voted Apnimed as one of the Best Places to Work in 2024 and 2025!  
  
The Key Account Manager (KAM) will play a pivotal role in securing access and driving adoption of AD109 within the nation’s largest health systems and integrated delivery networks. Reporting to the National Sales Director, this senior field-based role owns a defined book of strategic accounts, engaging system-level clinical, pharmacy and administrative decision makers to establish formulary access, influence treatment protocols and pathways, and unlock the sleep and pulmonology centers within each system.  
  
This is a highly visible, entrepreneurial role requiring a strategic account planner with deep experience selling into complex health systems and navigating committee-driven decision making. The KAM carries no direct reports but leads a matrixed account team, including Regional Sales Leaders and sales specialists, Market Access, Medical Affairs and Marketing, to deliver one coordinated plan per account.  
  
**Key Job Duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Own a defined portfolio of strategic health systems and integrated delivery networks, mapping the decision-making structure of each and executing an account plan spanning pre-launch preparation, launch execution and post launch growth
* Map and build relationships across all relevant stakeholders within an account, including physicians, clinical staff, pharmacy, administration, and other decision-influencers.
* Partner with Market Access to pull through national and regional payer coverage at the system level
* Influence system treatment protocols, order sets, care pathways and referral flows to support identification and treatment of patients with obstructive sleep apnea
* Lead pre-launch and launch-readiness activities within assigned key accounts, including stakeholder mapping and understanding of patient journey
* Lead the matrixed account team without direct authority, aligning field sales, Market Access, Medical Affairs and Marketing behind one coordinated plan per account
* Identify and support system-level screening, diagnostic and care coordination initiatives that expand appropriate patient identification
* Establish account-level KPIs to measure access, adoption and pull-through, and surface system trends, access barriers and competitive intelligence to commercial leadership
* Ensure all account activity is conducted in full compliance with company policy, industry codes and applicable regulations

**Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of biopharmaceutical commercial experience, including 3+ years in key account management, health system or institutional selling
* Demonstrated success securing formulary access and driving protocol or pathway change within large health systems and integrated delivery networks
* Proven track record of successful product launches, ideally in specialty or CNS-related markets
* Strong working knowledge of health system economics, reimbursement, specialty pharmacy and utilization management
* Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority
* Strong strategic account planning skills with the ability to execute tactically in a fast-paced environment
* Excellent communication, executive presence and stakeholder management skills
* Field-based role; must reside within the assigned geography and be able to travel extensively, including overnight travel
* Valid driver’s license and an acceptable driving record
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, PharmD, or similar) preferred

**What Apnimed Offers:**

* 401(k) with company match
* Generous time off for vacation
* Generous Company paid benefits
* Flexible working environment
* Motivated and experienced team

**Location and Other Information:**

* This is a field-based role; the KAM must reside within the assigned geography.
* Apnimed is an EEO employer committed to an exciting, diverse, and enriching work environment.
* The annual base salary range for this position is $172,000 - $220,000.
* Please visit us at www.apnimed.com to learn more about our work with Obstructive Sleep Apnea

The Strategic Account Manager will support advertising account executives through the entire lifecycle of their clients' digital sponsorship, social campaigns, native advertising and event sponsorship campaigns. Post-sale, they will serve as the client's primary contact for campaign activation. Campaign activation responsibilities include coordinating between the client and internal fulfillment teams to ensure accurate and on-time launch of all campaigns, managing the timeline from sale to campaign launch. They will monitor campaign performance, escalating any issues to the account executive and their manager and provide mid-campaign updates to client as needed. Post-sale duties will include campaign reporting and presenting findings and recommendations for future campaigns to account executive and/or client. This individual will be accountable for their accounts and focus on the success of their client's campaigns, identifying opportunities for upselling and retention of the revenue. This individual will be well versed in all owned and operated products (AJC.com, Access Atlanta, Dawgnation.com, UATL, e-paper, apps, AJCamp, & all other new product development) and manage up to $5M in revenue.  
  
Individuals in this position will be able to work under high pressure, deadline-driven time frames, be self-starters, problem solvers, and detail oriented, as well as provide administrative and customer support related to post-sale activities.  
  
**Job Responsibilities**  
  
**Strategy**  

* Consultatively support, retain, and grow customer accounts in conjunction with account executives
* Achieve budgeted annual revenue retention rates on key accounts
* Identify opportunities and brainstorm on new revenue streams with account executives and internal strategic teams

  
**Pre-Sales**  

* Help support pre-sale strategy team in any brand details for sales pitches
* Attend prospect and upsell pitch meetings with account executives and strategy team where needed

  
**Campaign Activation**  

* Responsible for managing and confirming accurate, timely execution of O&O campaigns
* Utilize sales automation systems (CRM, Ticketing, creative workflow, and reporting dashboards) to manage day-to-day activity and update AE and manager on client performance through system-generated reports and customer dashboard
* Acts as a subject matter expert for O&O digital and products
* Maintain communication and relationships with key partners in ad operations, the sales team and other departments for fulfillment of all campaigns
* Manage communication on deadlines for all campaign assets

  
**Post-Sales**  

* Manage post-sale client communication and meeting set-up
* Coordinate with client on any assets needed to complete their campaign
* Manage the timing of client campaigns and ensure flawless execution
* Create and communicate campaign reporting with insights to clients and internal stakeholders

  
**Education and Experience**  

* Bachelor's degree in a related discipline and 2 years' experience Marketing/Advertising experience. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master's degree and up to 2 years' experience; or 6 years' experience in a related field
* Google Analytics preferred. Google Ad Manager knowledge preferred
* Strong computer skills (Microsoft Office Suite)
* Experience with Project Management Software (Monday.com or other), Reporting dashboards (Pressboard or other) , and Salesforce preferred
* Participated in or has led client meetings and presentations
* Understanding of digital media, programmatic campaigns, analytics, and reporting

jobs.title: Assistant Community Manager
jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

Asset Living is a third-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single-family home rentals, affordable housing, build-to-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.

  

Asset Living is a fast-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.

  

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

**ASSISTANT COMMUNITY MANAGER**

The Assistant Community Manager is responsible for overseeing, under the supervision of the Community Manager, the everyday operations and financial functions of the housing community. As the Assistant Community Manager, you will play a vital role in the delinquency and collection of rent to optimize the property's cash flow and financial position. As an Assistant Community Manager, you will manage all phases of the operations, including personnel, leasing, maintenance, financial, administration & risk management in the absence of the Community Manager. As an onsite leader, you will supervise all aspects of the property and staff to ensure compliance with the company's policies and procedures, safety and fair housing guidelines, and liability concerns.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

Financial Management

* Responsible for posting all payments and income received from all applicants, current residents, and non-current residents accurately, timely, and efficiently.
* Responsible for processing and reconciling daily all account receivables.
* Monitor and follow up on bad debt to include preparation of late notices, resident and guarantor contact, and filing evictions.
* Responsible for helping the property meet budgeted revenues, expenses, and Net Operating Income.
* Responsible for posting of all charges to resident and non-current resident accounts; to also include bill back of utilities where applicable.
* Responsible for all end-of-the-month closing procedures and reporting.
* Maintain accurate and organized records; audit resident files to ensure accurate records.
* Responsible for walking units and posting all move-out charges, statements, and security deposit refunds.

Personnel Management

* Regular/daily onsite attendance is required
* Use consistent techniques & company directives to screen, hire, train, coach, and develop onsite staff.
* Ensure the effectiveness of staff through ongoing training, coaching, counseling, and guidance in compliance with Asset training benchmarks.
* Promote harmony and quality job performance of staff through support and effective leadership.
* Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures.
* Strategic Leasing Management
* Ensure staff leasing techniques are effective in obtaining closure, follow-up procedures met, signing/documentation of leases, and reporting systems are accurate and up to date.
* Implement marketing strategies & systems put in place by the annual marketing plan.
* Deal with resident complaints, concerns, and requests to ensure resident satisfaction.
* Develop and implement resident retention programs (i.e., resident functions, special promotions, monthly newsletter, etc.)
* Effectively show, lease, and move in prospective residents.

jobs.description:
**Location:** Des Plaines, IL **Category:** Staff **Job Type:** Full Time Staff **Posted On:** Thu Oct 8 2026 **Job Description:**  
  

**Basic Function and Responsibility:**

Reporting to the Manager of the Career Development Center, the Career Development Coordinator delivers high-impact programmatic support and direct career coaching to advance student career readiness, persistence, and employment outcomes. The role provides comprehensive career guidance to credit and non-credit students, alumni, and community members, supports career/major exploration and pathway mapping, and develops job-search strategies informed by labor-market data. The Coordinator also helps design, implement, and improve career and workforce development programs and works with campus and community partners to connect students with internships, apprenticeships, and experiential learning opportunities.

**Characteristic Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Provide individualized and group-based career coaching to assist with major/educational pathways and career exploration, goal setting, and career pathway planning. Administer and interpret personality, major, and career assessment tools (e.g., Strong Interest Inventory) and translate into realistic, actionable career plans.
* Develop proactive outreach strategies to engage with students through one-on-one coaching sessions, classroom visits, presentations, workshops, and targeted campaigns to increase student utilization. Empower students to make well-informed, researched decisions about majors/educational pathways, careers, or internships/apprenticeships.
* Provide job search support, including resume and cover letter development, interview preparation (including mock interviews), LinkedIn optimization, and career competency development aligned with the National Association of Colleges and Employers (NACE). Offer students constructive, instructional feedback to assist with applications and enhance job readiness.
* Coordinate and facilitate career development workshops, presentations, and outreach activities for students and campus partners in multiple modalities (in-person, virtual, and hybrid).
* Collaborate with program faculty and chairs to collect and monitor job placement opportunities; support students in securing professional employment; and gather data to prepare reports on job development and placement initiatives.
* Establish and cultivate employer and industry partnerships to increase recruitment efforts and expand employment opportunities for students.
* Collaborate with Adult Continuing Education, Workforce Development (ACE-WD), Work-Based Learning, and the Small Business Development Center to organize and execute job/career fairs, including student preparation, soliciting employer participation, marketing events to the appropriate audiences, outcome tracking, and coordinating miscellaneous logistical elements.
* Collaborate with the Adult Continuing Education and Workforce Development (ACE-WD) division to teach new and continuing students how to access career exploration and non-credit-to-credit support programs and services.
* Collect, analyze, and report data related to student engagement, program participation, and employment outcomes for institutional and accreditation purposes.
* Participate in early-exposure activities aligned with the pathways-to-opportunity model, team meetings, professional development, and cross-training to enhance service delivery.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

 **Job Requirements:**

**Qualifications and Working Conditions:**

* Bachelor's degree required. An advanced degree in higher education, counseling, psychology, or a related field is preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of 2 years' professional experience in career services, workforce development, higher education, or human resources. Experience working with undecided college students preferred.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Certified Career Services Provider, Global Career Development Facilitator) are a plus.
* Proficiency with career services platforms (Handshake, Symplicity, etc.) and CRM systems (Salesforce preferred): strong data collection and reporting skills.
* Strong understanding of higher education transfer/admissions processes and labor market information to align students' academic plans with employment opportunities.
* Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication; customer service orientation; ability to establish productive relationships with students, faculty, staff, and employers; strong organizational, planning, and time-management skills; ability to coordinate multiple initiatives and meet deadlines.
* Ability to interact respectfully and tactfully with diverse populations, maintain confidential records, and work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams.

**Physical Demands:**

Mobility to move from building to building on-campus and to visit off-campus entities. Work is performed in a general office environment and is sedentary in nature?little or no exposure to adverse working conditions.

 **Additional Information:**

**HOURS: Monday - Friday 8:15 am - 5:00 pm**

* Influence system treatment protocols, order sets, care pathways and referral flows to support identification and treatment of patients with obstructive sleep apnea
* Lead pre-launch and launch-readiness activities within assigned key accounts, including stakeholder mapping and understanding of patient journey
* Lead the matrixed account team without direct authority, aligning field sales, Market Access, Medical Affairs and Marketing behind one coordinated plan per account

new_jobs.description:
**Location:** Los Angeles, California
  
  
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
Join us in building a more inclusive world at Braille Institute of America. We are undertaking one of the most transformative initiatives in our history, planning our next century of success in serving the blind and visually impaired communities.
  
Through our 2025-2027 strategic planning process, we identified the next generation opportunities to advance critical initiatives in areas such as customer research; the expansion and transformation of current programs and services; the development of new nationally and internationally accessible programs; the creation of dynamic new strategic partnerships; and the alignment of our mission, strategy, and resources.
  
If you are ready to join a dynamic organization transforming the lives of individuals experiencing vision loss, we want you on our team.
  
  
WHO WE ARE
  
**At Braille Institute, we are driven by a shared purpose:** to serve the blind and low vision community. We come together to make a meaningful difference in the lives of others, finding fulfillment in the impact we create. We believe in fostering a culture that is collaborative, inclusive, and flexible.
  
We understand the importance of work-life balance, valuing both personal and professional fulfillment. Here, you'll find an environment that supports your well-being while providing opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive alongside colleagues who are sighted and visually impaired.
  
Join us in embracing technology and innovation as we shape the future of accessibility and positively transform the lives of those with vision loss.
  
  
JOB DESCRIPTION
  
  
General Expectations
  
  
All employees within Braille Institute are expected to support the organization’s mission, vision and values, work cooperatively with others, contribute to the positive morale of the department/center and be a respected representative of the organization.
  
  
Job Summary
  
  
The Production Coordinator is responsible for the planning, coordination, and live execution of all synchronous virtual learning sessions, events, and programs hosted on the Vision Support America (VSA) website and Braille Institute digital platforms. This role serves as the operational hub between Programs, Marketing, Information Technology, and Customer Service, ensuring that every live session is published accurately, supported technically, and delivered in a manner that reflects the organization’s commitment to accessibility and member experience.
  
  
Beyond live session management, the Production Coordinator plays an active quality-improvement role — analyzing session recordings, survey data, and participant feedback to identify patterns and opportunities for improvement, and providing direct coaching and support to session presenters. The position requires a practitioner who understands both the technical demands of virtual production and the specific needs of the organization’s primary audience: older adults who are new to vision loss.
  
  
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  
  
Session Scheduling, Confirmation, and Publishing
  

* Coordinate with Marketing and Programs to confirm all online offerings — learning sessions, support groups, events, and special programs — for both Vision Support America and Braille Institute platforms.
* Manage the end-to-end publishing workflow in partnership with IT, ensuring all sessions are accurately listed, linked, and accessible on the VSA website and any associated platforms prior to promotion.
* Maintain and update the master session calendar in Monday.com, ensuring accurate and current information is available to all stakeholders.
* Verify that registration links, Zoom or Teams meeting configurations, confirmation emails, and reminder communications are functioning correctly before each session is promoted.
* Identify and resolve scheduling conflicts, duplicate listings, or technical configuration errors before they reach participants.
* Ensure that all published session information — titles, descriptions, dates, times, access links, and accessibility accommodations — is accurate and consistent across all channels.

Live Session Production Support
  

* Serve as co-host for live synchronous learning sessions, with primary responsibility for technical setup, link and meeting management, and participant support throughout each session.
* Manage the participant chat during live sessions — responding to questions, escalating issues to the presenter, noting feedback, and maintaining an accessible and welcoming environment in the chat space.
* Provide elevated production support for high-registration and high-visibility sessions, including pre-session technical checks, backup protocol management, and real-time troubleshooting.
* Coordinate audio and video setup, screen-share access, captioning activation, and any assistive technology configurations required for each session.
* Brief presenters prior to each session on platform controls, accessibility features, participant management, and any session-specific logistics.
* Monitor session quality in real time — audio clarity, video stability, caption accuracy, and participant accessibility — and intervene or escalate when issues arise.
* Maintain a post-session incident log documenting any technical issues, participant access barriers, or presenter needs that require follow-up.

Content Review and Quality Identification
  

* Review session recordings to identify audio and video segments that exemplify strong participant engagement, effective presenter technique, or positive member feedback — as well as segments that reflect technical problems, participant confusion, or opportunities for improvement.
* Flag and document specific moments in recordings for use in presenter coaching, quality reporting, or organizational learning.
* Maintain a structured log of identified segments with timestamps, session context, and recommended action or use.

Location Costa Mesa, California, 92626 Category Corporate JR202639807 Onsite

  

Digital Marketing Strategist  
  

The Digital Marketing Strategist leads and coordinates integrated digital marketing initiatives for Insurance Marketing, supporting performance and brand objectives across Auto, Home, and Life Insurance.

The role is centered on three core pillars: strategic testing, user experience, and advertising operations and technology. This individual connects marketing, creative, media, analytics, technology, and agency partners to move initiatives from strategy through execution.

* Experience coordinating integrated campaigns and cross-functional projects.
* Working knowledge of digital customer journeys, website optimization, paid media, campaign tracking, and performance measurement.

The Event Operations Manager, Speaker Programs is the internal operational owner for assigned speaker bureaus and programs, from bureau setup through program closeout. * You have a Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

* Experience supporting structured Commercial, Medical, regulatory, or other content-review and approval processes.

The Knight First Amendment Institute defends the freedoms of speech and the press in the digital age through strategic litigation, research, and public education. We aim to promote a system of free expression that is open and inclusive, that broadens and elevates public discourse, and that fosters creativity, accountability, and effective self-government.

Since its establishment in 2016, the Institute has filed precedent-setting litigation, undertaken major interdisciplinary research initiatives, and become an influential voice in debates about the freedoms of speech and the press in the digital age. Through its research program, the Institute has hosted leading thinkers as visiting scholars and published influential essays focused on emerging threats to the system of free expression. ### **The Opportunity**

Are you a results-driven sales professional with over five years of experience in managing enterprise accounts and a passion for building lasting client relationships? ### **Your Role**

* Manage a portfolio of enterprise accounts to drive revenue growth and achieve sales targets.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders within assigned accounts.
* Identify client needs and align solutions to meet their business objectives.

* Conduct regular business reviews to assess performance, uncover opportunities, and mitigate risks.
* Lead negotiations and close contracts while ensuring compliance with company policies.
* Monitor market trends and competitor activities to inform sales strategy.
* Set and achieve objectives for client satisfaction and revenue growth within the first year.

### **What You Will Bring**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in enterprise account management or related field.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
* Effective problem-solving and analytical thinking abilities.
* Familiarity with remote sales strategies and tools.
* Adaptability to a fast-paced and changing environment.
* Understanding of market trends and industry dynamics.

### **Work Arrangement**

Remote: This position is primarily remote. There is no specific in-office requirement, however, there may be circumstances where you may be required to come into a local office for a specific purpose, and/or to travel to other locations based on business needs.

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between USD $ 300,000 and USD $ 450,000 per year.

However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Our application deadline is 40 days from the date of posting. In good faith, the posting may be removed prior to this date if the position is filled or extended in good faith.

new_jobs.description:

*week per company policy.*

The annual salary range for this role in New York is $105,000-$120,000.

The World Economic Forum, committed to improving the state of the world, is the international organization for public-private cooperation. The Forum engages the foremost political, business and other leaders of society to shape global, regional and industry agendas.

**Why we are recruiting**

As a partnership organization and through the Business Engagement teams, the World Economic Forum engages the private sector to address industry, regional and systemic issues. Partners benefit from and contribute to the global knowledge base through working closely with the Forum to set the intellectual agenda of Forum gatherings, drive the insight agenda of its publications and steer the impact of its initiatives.

Structured geographically, the Global Industries Team is responsible for building and managing the world’s premier communities of business executives.

We are currently seeking an Account Manager (internal title Senior Account Associate, Communication and Technology Industries), who will be tasked to manage a portfolio of Partner accounts and engage relevant executives in the Forum’s events, initiatives and communities. The role will serve as the primary point of contact for assigned organizations; develop and implement tailored engagement strategies plans that strengthen relationships with CEOs and C-suite executives and identify opportunities to strengthen the engagement with the Forum.

  

The portfolio is primarily composed of high-growth companies shaping the next generation of technology, business models, and critical infrastructure, and are increasingly looking to engage with global business, government, and civil society leaders on issues of systemic importance.

**Reporting Lines and Interactions**

The role will interact with our partners, and across multiple teams ranging from Finance, Contract Management to Industry, Centre and Government engagement groups. The person will report to the Senior Manager, Communications and Technology.

**Main** **responsibilities**

* **Partner relationship management**: Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior Partner representatives; lead regular engagement with Partners to understand their strategic priorities; collaborate with relevant internal stakeholders to deliver a seamless Partner experience. Engage partners in relevant industry work.
* **Portfolio growth and account management**: Monitor Partner engagement, business developments and overall account health to identify opportunities for partnership growth and expansion; proactively identify partnership risks and develop retention strategies in collaboration with the Head of Industry to maximize long-term Partner value.
* **Partner engagement and event strategy:** Develop tailored engagement plans strategies for Partners; shape executive agendas identify relevant opportunities for executive participation, speaking roles and leadership interactions and ensure effective follow-up to maximize engagement outcomes.
* **Cross-functional collaboration**: Work closely with Industry, Regional, Centre, Event, Finance and Partner Development teams to coordinate Partner activities; provide strategic guidance to Account Associates on operational delivery and ensure high-quality execution across the Partner lifecycle.

**Success in this role will be measured by:**

* **Partner engagement**: Strong and trusted relationships with senior executives, reflected in sustained engagement across Forum activities.
* **Partner retention**: High retention rates and proactive management of at-risk accounts through effective engagement strategies.
* **Cross-functional delivery Collaboration and leadership**: Effective coordination across internal teams, enabling a seamless Partner experience and consistent knowledge sharing.

**Preferred Requirements and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Business, Economics, Management or another relevant field.
* Knowledge and understanding of the business and political landscape of Communications and Technology companies.
* 4+ years of full-time experience in a business development or relationship management role in a fast-changing professional environment. Working knowledge and experience of sales cycle management, account management, market research is a must.
* Ability to build and maintain positive relationship with partners that enable the Forum to drive new business opportunities
* Excellent organizational, project and time management skills, a strong work ethic, and high attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with and manage expectations of senior stakeholders
* Agile team player who enjoys working in a highly collaborative, culturally diverse, fast-paced, and rapidly evolving environment.
* Deep passion for the future of the business in the emerging world, the role it plays within the global context, and its potential impact on society and the individual
* Responsible, independent, and self-driven with a learning mindset and a positive attitude
* Proficient in working with MS Office and Salesforce, experience with other CRM tools a plus.
* Proficiency in working with AI solutions – knowledge of Chat GPT and Slack a plus.

**Why join us?**

Join an independent and impartial organization with over 55 years of connecting leaders to make sense of global challenges and move the world forward together.

new_jobs.title: Business Development & Marketing Assistant
new_jobs.description:
Barack Ferrazzano's Business Development & Marketing department is looking to expand by adding a Business Development & Marketing Assistant. The Business Development & Marketing Assistant will support the Firm's strategic growth initiatives, assist with marketing campaigns, and help coordinate business development projects. Working closely with and under the guidance of the Business Development & Marketing Manager, this position offers the opportunity to learn directly from and collaborate with attorneys, practice group leaders, and administrative teams across the firm.

This role is well suited for a recent college graduate or early-career professional (0–2 years of experience) who is eager to learn, detail-oriented, organized, and ready to build foundational marketing and business development skills in a fast-paced, team-oriented, professional services environment.

**Position:** Business Development & Marketing Assistant

**Dept./Practice Group:** Business Development & Marketing

**FLSA:** Nonexempt

**Reports To:** Business Development & Marketing Manager

**Manages Others:** No

**Salary:** $63,000.00 - $72,000.00 commensurate with experience

**Hours:** 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM, (35-hour work week), Monday - Friday, Hybrid: Tuesday-Thursday in Office with Monday & Friday Remote; Occasional overtime

**Job Summary:** The Business Development & Marketing Assistant will support the firm's strategic growth initiatives, assist with marketing campaigns, and help coordinate business development projects. Working closely with and under the guidance of the Business Development & Marketing Manager, this position offers the opportunity to learn directly from and collaborate with attorneys, practice group leaders, and administrative teams across the firm.

The Assistant will assist with marketing materials, website and social media content updates, events, client proposals and RFP responses, and support the firm's CRM and other marketing tools. This role is well suited for a recent college graduate or early-career professional (0–2 years of experience) who is eager to learn, detail-oriented, organized, and ready to build foundational marketing and business development skills in a fast-paced, team-oriented, professional services environment.

**Responsibilities:**

**Digital Content & Brand Management**

* Assist with writing, editing, and proofreading marketing and business development materials, including practice descriptions, attorney bios, and website content.
* Support updates to the firm's website, intranet, and social media channels, including assisting with day-to-day posting, scheduling, and engagement on LinkedIn.
* Help maintain the firmwide social media calendar and associated content.
* Assist with basic image and graphic edits using Canva/Adobe Creative Suite.
* Support consistent use of firm branding across internal and external communications.

**Event Planning & Execution**

* Assist with coordinating internal and external firm events, sponsorships, and webinars.
* Help draft and distribute invitations using Vuture (e-marketing software).
* Support tracking of event RSVPs, mailing lists, and day-of logistics.
* Assist with sourcing and ordering firm-branded materials and custom items for events.

**Proposals, Pitches & Client Development**

* Assist in drafting and formatting proposals, RFP responses, and pitch presentations.
* Help prepare customized team sheets and meeting materials for client opportunities.
* Support attorneys and practice groups in gathering timely, accurate deliverables.

**Public Relations & Communications**

* Help maintain the firm's CRM system, mailing lists, and contact records.
* Assist with drafting client alerts, press releases, and news items.
* Support opportunities to promote client and firm successes.

**Surveys, Rankings & Directories**

* Assist in preparing submissions for legal rankings, directories, and awards.
* Help coordinate with attorneys to gather necessary information.
* Support updating current firm and attorney profiles across platforms.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree required; preferably in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Legal Studies, or related field.
* 0–2 years of marketing, communications, or business development experience; prior internship experience in a law firm, professional services, or agency environment is a plus.

**Technical Proficiency**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and LinkedIn.
* Exposure to, or willingness to learn, CRM databases, e-marketing tools (Vuture), and webinar platforms (On24, Zoom).
* General comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude) is a plus.
* Basic familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop) and/or Canva is a plus; willingness to learn is required.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills– attention to detail is a must.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong organizational and project management skills and a proactive, eager-to-learn mindset.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively with attorneys, staff, vendors, and firm leadership.
* Professional demeanor, client-service oriented, and ability to maintain confidentiality.

**Working Conditions and Physical Effort:**

* Work is normally performed in a typical office work environment at an assigned station
* The Firm will consider hybrid work options based on the job needs for this position
* Limited physical effort required and very limited exposure to physical risk
* Must be able to comply with all safety requirements in our workplace

**Disclaimer:**

Incumbents must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily and, if requested, reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship.
